sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसस्तस्य राज्ञो निवेशनम् || १-१८-४८

विविशुः पूजितास्तेन निषेदुश्च यथार्हतः |

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
अथ हृष्टमना राजा विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम् || १-१८-४९

उवाच परमोदारो हृष्टस्तमभिपूजयन् |

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
यथामृतस्य संप्राप्तिर्यथा वर्षमनूदके || १-१८-५०

यथा सदृशदारेषु पुत्रजन्माप्रजस्य वै |

प्रणष्टस्य यथा लाभो यथा हर्षो महोदये || १-१८-५१

तथैवागमनं मन्ये स्वागतं ते महामुने |
translation:
"I deem your arrival is in the vein of mortals attaining ambrosia, rainfall in a droughty 
land, a barren father begetting a son through his deserving wife, a regain of long lost treasures, 
and the gladness at a great happening, oh, great saint, welcome to you." [1-18-50b, 51, 52a]

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
कं च ते परमं कामं करोमि किमु हर्षितः || १-१८-५२

पात्रभूतोऽसि मे ब्रह्मन् दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि मानद |

अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जीवितं च सुजीवितम् || १-१८-५३

यस्माद् विप्रेन्द्रमद्राक्षं सुप्रभाता निशा मम |
translation:
"Oh, Brahman, as I am the one who is delighted for your arrival, and as you are the most eligible 
recipient from me, what is that choicest object of yours to be fulfilled by me, and in which 
way. Oh, endower of respect, for me your arrival is fortunate whereby my birth is fructified 
and my life f

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
पूर्वं राजर्षिशब्देन तपसा द्योतितप्रभः || १-१८-५४

ब्रह्मर्षित्वमनुप्राप्तः पूज्योऽसि बहुधा मया |
translation:
"Originally your glory was explicit by your title kingly-sage, and subsequently you 
attained the Absolute-sainthood by your ascesis, and you are venerable to me, in many 
ways." [1-18-54b, 55a]

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
तदद्भुतमभूत् विप्र पवित्रं परमं मम || १-१८-५५

शुभक्षेत्रगतश्चाहं तव संदर्शनात् प्रभो |
translation:
"Oh, Brahman, thereby your arrival at my place is surprising and ideally sacred to me, and 
by your very appearance I have become one who has gone on a quiet pilgrimage. [1-18-55b, 56a]

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
ब्रूहि यत् प्रार्थितं तुभ्यं कार्यमागमनं प्रति || १-१८-५६

इच्छाम्यनुगृहीतोऽहं त्वदर्थं परिवृद्धये |
translation:
"You may tell me, entreating which work your arrival chanced here and I feel that I am indeed 
blessed and wish to make it happen to achieve results. [1-18-56b, 57a]

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
कार्यस्य न विमर्शं च गंतुमर्हसि सुव्रत || १-१८-५७

कर्ता चाहमशेषेण दैवतं हि भवान् मम |

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
मम चायमनुप्राप्तो महानभ्युदयो द्विज |

तवागमनजः कृत्स्नो धर्मश्चानुत्तमो द्विज || १-१८-५८
translation:
"Oh, Brahman, this is the great prosperity that bechanced on me, and this is propriety in 
its entirety that bechanced on me, as a result of your arrival. [1-18-58b, c]

sargaTitle: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna took births
sanskrit:
इति हृदयसुखं निशम्य वाक्यम्

श्रुतिसुखमात्मवता विनीतमुक्तम् |

प्रथितगुणयशा गुणैर्विशिष्टः

परमऋषिः परमं जगाम हर्षम् || १-१८-५९

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राजसिंहस्य वाक्यमद्भुतविस्तरम् |

			हृष्टरोमा महातेजा विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत || १-१९-१

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
सदृशं राजशार्दूल तवैतद्भुवि नान्यथा |

			महावंशप्रसूतस्य वसिष्ठव्यपदेशिनः || १-१९-२
translation:
"Oh, tigerly king, to you befitting are these words and to none else, as you are 
			born in a great dynasty and tutored by Vashishta. [1-19-2]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
यत्तु मे हृद्गतं वाक्यं तस्य कार्यस्य निश्चयम् |

			कुरुष्व राजशार्दूल भव सत्यप्रतिश्रवाः || १-१९-३
translation:
"What concerns I have in my heart I am going to say, and you take decision thereof, 
			oh, tigerly-king, and become truthful to your promises. [1-19-3]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
अहं नियममातिष्ठे सिद्ध्यर्थं पुरुषर्षभ |

			तस्य विघ्नकरौ द्वौ तु राक्षसौ कामरूपिणौ || १-१९-४
translation:
"These days I am abiding by a sacrificial vow to attain a spiritual goal but, 
			oh, best one among men, two guise changing demons as causing obstacles to that 
			ritual. [1-19-4]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
व्रते मे बहुशश्चीर्णे समाप्त्यां राक्षसाविमौ |

			मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ || १-१९-५

			तौ मांसरुधिरौघेण वेदिं तामभ्यवर्षताम् |
translation:
"At the near end of almost completed ritual of mine two valiant and well-trained 
			demons, namely Mareecha and Subaahu, are drenching the Altar of Fire with streams 
			of meat and blood. [1-19-5, 6a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
अवधूते तथाभूते तस्मिन्नियमनिश्चये || १-१९-६

			कृतश्रमो निरुत्साहस्तस्माद्देशादपाक्रमे |
translation:
"When the ritual vow is thus ravaged I, as the one who exerted myself for the 
			ritual, had to depart from that place, unenthusiastically. [1-19-6n, 7a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
न च मे क्रोधमुत्स्रष्टुं बुद्धिर्भवति पार्थिव || १-१९-७

			तथाभूता हि सा चर्या न शापस्तत्र मुच्यते |
translation:
"And to me there is no will to let loose my anger, oh, king, as no curse shall 
			be issued under vows, and like that the activity during rituals shall be inoffensive, 
			isn't it. [1-19-7b, 8a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
स्वपुत्रं राजशार्दूल रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् || १-१९-८

			काकपक्षधरं शूरं ज्येष्ठं मे दातुमर्हसि |
translation:
"As such, oh, tigerly king, it will be apt of you spare the services of that brave 
			one whose valour itself is his truthfulness, that youngling whose hair locks are 
			all the more jet black like crow wings on either side of his head, spare that 
			eldest son of yours, namely Rama. [1-19-8b, 9a

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
शक्तो ह्येष मया गुप्तो दिव्येन स्वेन तेजसा || १-१९-९

			राक्षसा ये विकर्तारस्तेषामपि विनाशने |
translation:
"Indeed, he is capable to eradicate those demons that are thwarting the ritual 
			by his own divine resplendence, and protected by me as well. [1-19-9b, 10a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
श्रेयश्चास्मै प्रदास्यामि बहुरूपं न संशयः || १-१९-१०

			त्रयाणामपि लोकानां येन ख्यातिं गमिष्यति |
translation:
"I will also accord many kinds of benefits to him by which he acquires renown 
			in all the three worlds, no doubt about it. [1-19-10b, 11a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
न च तौ राममासाद्य शक्तौ स्थातुं कथञ्चन || १-१९-११

			न च तौ राघवादन्यो हन्तुमुत्सहते पुमान् |
translation:
"Those two demons will be rendered incapable to stand fast on affronting Rama 
			in anywise, and none other than Raghava has the fortitude to eliminate those two. 
			[1-19-11b, 12a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
वीर्योत्सिक्तौ हि तौ पापौ कालपाशवशं गतौ || १-१९-१२

			रामस्य राजशार्दूल न पर्याप्तौ महात्मनः |
translation:
"Those two sinners that are berserk by their vigour have gone into the subjection 
			of death's noose, oh tigerly king, cannot counterbalance the great-souled Rama. 
			[1-19-12b, 13a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
न च पुत्रगतं स्नेहं कर्तुमर्हसि पार्थिव || १-१९-१३

			अहं ते प्रतिजानामि हतौ तौ विद्धि राक्षसौ |
translation:
"It will be unapt of you to show your paternal fondness, oh, king, upon my oath, 
			be assured that those two demons are eradicated. [1-19-13b, 14a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
अहं वेद्मि महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् || १-१९-१४

			वसिष्ठोऽपि महातेजा ये चेमे तपसि स्थिताः |
translation:
"I am sensible of that sublime-soul Rama, whose valour is his truthfulness, and 
			even this great resplendent Vashishta and these saints that are here are aware. 
			[1-19-14b, 15a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
यदि ते धर्मलाभं तु यशश्च परमं भुवि || १-१९-१५

			स्थिरमिच्छसि राजेन्द्र रामं मे दातुमर्हसि |
translation:
"If you wish to gain in value of probity, a long-lasting and paramount renown 
			on earth it will be apt of you to handover Rama to me. [1-19-15b, 16a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
यद्यभ्यनुज्ञां काकुत्स्थ ददते तव मंत्रिणः || १-१९-१६

			वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे ततो रामं विसर्जय |
translation:
"Oh, Dasharatha, you may send Rama if only your ministers and all the other elite 
			headed by Vashishta are going to give assent. [1-19-16b, 17a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
अभिप्रेतमसंसक्तमात्मजं दातुमर्हसि || १-१९-१७

			दशरात्रं हि यज्ञस्य रामं राजीवलोचनम् |
translation:
"It will be apt of you to send your choicest son, the lotus-eyed Rama, just for 
			ten days of the ritual without temporising. [1-19-17b, 18a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
नात्येति कालो यज्ञस्य यथायं मम राघव || १-१९-१८

			तथा कुरुष्व भद्रं ते मा च शोके मनः कृथाः |
translation:
"I wish you to take decision as to how my ritual's time is not lapsed, and 
			let safety betide you, let not your heart be rendered to grieve." Thus Vishvamitra 
			said to Dasharatha. [1-19-18b, 19a]

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा धर्मात्मा धर्मार्थसहितं वचः || १-१९-१९

			विरराम महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामतिः |

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
स तन्निशम्य राजेन्द्रो विश्वामित्रवचः शुभम् || १-१९-२०

			शोकेन महताविष्टश्चचाल च मुमोह च |

			लब्धसंज्ञस्तथोत्थाय व्यषीदत भयान्वितः || १-१९-२१

sargaTitle: Sage vishvamitra's arrival to take rAma along with him to guard ritual
sanskrit:
इति हृदयमनोविदारणं

			मुनिवचनं तदतीव शुश्रुवान् |

			नरपतिरभवन्महान् महात्मा

			व्यथितमनाः प्रचचाल चासनात् || १-१९-२२

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राजशार्दूलो विश्वामित्रस्य भाषितम् |

मुहूर्तमिव निस्सज्ञः सज्ञावानिदमब्रवीत् || १-२०-१

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
ऊनषोडशवर्षो मे रामो राजीवलोचनः |

न युद्धयोग्यतामस्य पश्यामि सह राक्षसैः || १-२०-२
translation:
""Less than sixteen years of age is my lotus-eyed Rama, and I see no warring aptitude to him 
with the demons. [1-20-2]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
इयमक्षौहिणी पूर्णा यस्याहं पतिरीश्वरः |

अनया संवृतो गत्वा योद्धाहं तैर्निशाचरैः || १-२०-३
translation:
"Here is the full-fledged battalion, called akShouhiNii senaa , 
for which I am the leader and controller, and fortified by this army I will go there to encounter 
those demons. [1-20-3]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
इमे शूराश्च विक्रान्ता भृत्या मेऽस्त्रविशारदाः |

योग्या रक्षोगणैर्योद्धुं न रामं नेतुमर्हसि || १-२०-४
translation:
"Brave and daring are these soldiers of mine, and as experts in weaponry they are the appropriate 
ones to combat the hordes of demons, but, it will be ungentle of you to take Rama with you. 
[1-20-4]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
अहमेव धनुष्पाणिर्गोप्ता समरमूर्धनि |

यावत् प्राणान् धरिष्यामि तावद्योत्स्ये निशाचरैः || १-२०-५
translation:
"I alone with bow in my hand can protect your ritual, and as long as I bear my lives so long 
I war with those nightwalkers staying in the van of war. [1-20-5]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
निर्विघ्ना व्रतचर्या सा भविष्यति सुरक्षिता |

अहं तत्रागमिष्यामि न रामं नेतुमर्हसि || १-२०-६
translation:
" I myself wish to come over there thereby the works of ritual will be well-guarded and unimpeded, 
but, taking Rama with you will be ungracious of you. [1-20-6]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
बालो ह्यकृतविद्यश्च न च वेत्ति बलाबलम् |

न चास्त्रबलसंयुक्तो न च युद्धविशारदः || १-२०-७

न चासौ रक्षसां योग्यः कूटयुद्धा हि ते ध्रुवम् |
translation:
"Why because, Rama is boy! And he is unschooled in his princely education; does he know the 
strengths and weaknesses of opponents - no; has he got the equipage of arsenal - no; has he 
any expertise in warfare - no; is he an equal to the demons - no; be that as it may, those 
demons definitely cond

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
विप्रयुक्तो हि रामेण मुहूर्तमपि नोत्सहे || १-२०-८

जीवितुं मुनिशार्दूल न रामं नेतुमर्हसि |
translation:
"Alienated from Rama I am disinclined to live even for a moment, oh, tigerly sage, hence taking 
Rama with you will be unjust. [1-20-8b, 9a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
यदि वा राघवं ब्रह्मन्नेतुमिच्छसि सुव्रत || १-२०-९

चतुरंगसमायुक्तं मया सह च तं नय |
translation:
"Otherwise, oh, Brahman with best vows, if you so wish to take Rama along with you, you lead 
him off along with me, and along with my four kinds of troops. [1-20-9b, 10a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
षष्टिर्वर्षसहस्राणि जातस्य मम कौशिक || १-२०-१०

कृच्छ्रेणोत्पादितश्चायं न रामं नेतुमर्हसि |
translation:
"Sixty thousand years have passed from my birth, oh! Vishvamitra, and this Rama is engendered 
at this age, that too with tribulations, hence taking Rama with you will be inappropriate 
of you. [1-20-10b, 11a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
चतुर्णामात्मजानां हि प्रीतिः परमिका मम || १-२०-११

ज्येष्ठे धर्मप्रधाने च न रामं नेतुमर्हसि |
translation:
"I will have exceptional affection for all of my four sons, isn't it, and among them Rama 
has a significance in the matter of his descent as an eldest son, hence taking Rama with you 
will be unjust of you. [1-20-11b, 12a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
किं वीर्या राक्षसास्ते च कस्य पुत्राश्च के च ते || १-२०-१२

कथं प्रमाणाः के चैतान् रक्षन्ति मुनिपुंगव |
translation:
"Oh, eminent sage, of what fortitude are those demons? Whose sons are they? Who are they? 
How is their size and shape? Also who protects all of them? [1-20-12b, 13a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
कथं च प्रतिकर्तव्यं तेषां रामेण रक्षसाम् || १-२०-१३

मामकैर्वा बलैर्ब्रह्मन् मया वा कूटयोधिनाम् |
translation:
"Oh, Brahman, how Rama, or my forces, or I myself have to retaliate those demons that are 
deceitful militants. [1-20-13b, 14a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
सर्वं मे शंस भगवन् कथं तेषां मया रणे|| १-२०-१४

स्थातव्यं दुष्टभावानां वीर्योत्सिक्ता हि राक्षसाः |

तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत || १-२०-१५
translation:
"Tell me all that, oh, god, how I have to carry on when warring with those evil minded demons, 
for the demons will be delirious by their audacity, isn't it..." Thus Dasharatha asked Vishvamitra 
insistently. On hearing those words Sage Vishvamitra replied this way. [1-20-14b, 15]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
पौलस्त्यवंशप्रभवो रावणो नाम राक्षसः |

स ब्रह्मणा दत्तवरस्त्रैलोक्यं बाधते भृशम् || १-२०-१६

महाबलो महावीर्यो राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः |
translation:
"One born in Paulastya dynasty, an extremely mighty and exceedingly brave demon named Ravana 
is there, and he with the boon given by Brahma, and accompanied with many other demons is 
torturing the triad of worlds, contemptuously. [1-20-16, 17a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
श्रूयते च महाराजा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः || १-२०-१७

साक्षाद्वैश्रवणभ्राता पुत्रो विश्रवसो मुनेः |
translation:
"Unequivocally that chief of demons is the brother of Kubera and the son of sage Vishravasa, 
thus we hear. [1-20-17b, 18a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
यदा न खलु यज्ञस्य विघ्नकर्ता महाबलः || १-२०-१८

तेन संचोदितौ तौ तु राक्षसौ च महाबलौ |

मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च यज्ञविघ्नं करिष्यतः || १-२०-१९
translation:
"That formidable Ravana is not a devastator of rituals by himself, even so, two very mighty 
demons called Mareecha and Subaahu will cause devastating hindrances to rituals, instigated 
by him." Thus Sage Vishvamitra said to Dasharatha. [1-20-18b, 19]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
इत्युक्तो मुनिना तेन राजोवाच मुनिं तदा |

न हि शक्तोऽस्मि संग्रामे स्थातुं तस्य दुरात्मनः || १-२०-२०

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
स त्वं प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कुरुष्व मम पुत्रके |

मम चैवाल्पभाग्यस्य दैवतं हि भवान् गुरुः || १-२०-२१
translation:
"You are the knower of probity, such as you are, you may please bestow benevolence upon my 
boyish son, as well on a less fortunate one like me too, and as our mentor you are indeed 
a god of ours. [1-20-21]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
देवदानवगंधर्वा यक्षाः पतगपन्नगाः|

न शक्ता रावणं सोढुं किं पुनर्मानवा युधि || १-२०-२२
translation:
"Gods, demons, celestial beings like gandharva-s, yaksha-s, winged and reptile beings 
are incapable to bear the brunt of that Ravana in fight, why tell again about humans. [1-20-22]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
स तु वीर्यवतां वीर्यमादत्ते युधि रावणः |

तेन चाहं न शक्तोऽस्मि संयोद्धुं तस्य वा बलैः || १-२०-२३

सबलो वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ सहितो वा ममात्मजैः |
translation:
"But that Ravana depletes the valour of valorous opponents in a battle, oh, eminent sage, 
either with my entire forces, or with all my sons I am inadequate to grapple with all his 
forces, or with him, individually. [1-20-23, 24a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
कथमप्यमरप्रख्यं संग्रामाणामकोविदम् || १-२०-२४

बालं मे तनयं ब्रह्मन्नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम् |
translation:
"My boyish son is godlike and unfledged in warfare, oh, Brahman, and he is the one who alleviates 
me from punnama naraka the hell of sonless fathers... no, I cannot 
spare my son in anyway. [1-20-24b, 25a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
अथ कालोपमौ युद्धे सुतौ सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः || १-२०-२५

यज्ञविघ्नकरौ तौ ते नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम् |
translation:
"Further, those saboteurs of your ritual namely Mareecha and Subaahu, are similar to Death-god 
and the descendents of the earliest demons and subverters of rituals, namely Sunda and Upasunda, 
no, I cannot spare my son, in any case. [1-20-25b, 26a]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ || १-२०-२६

तयोरन्यतरं योद्धुं यास्यामि ससुहृद्गणः |

अन्यथा त्वनुनेष्यामि भवन्तं सह बान्धवैः || १-२०-२७
translation:
"Mareecha and Subaahu are well-trained and valorous ones, hence I will proceed with all my 
friendly forces to war with either of those two demons, otherwise, I along with all my relatives 
implore upon you for your exoneration in my failure to comply my own promises. [1-20-26b, 
27]

sargaTitle: dasharatha's dissent to spare rAma's servicees
sanskrit:
इति नरपतिजल्पनाद्द्विजेन्द्रं

कुशिकसुतं सुमहान् विवेश मन्युः |

सुहुत इव मखेऽग्निराज्यसिक्तः

समभवदुज्वलितो महर्षिवह्निः || १-२०-२८

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य स्नेहपर्याकुलाक्षरम् |

			समन्युः कौशिको वाक्यं प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम् || १-२१-१

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
पूर्वमर्थं प्रतिश्रुत्य प्रतिज्ञां हातुमिच्छसि |

			राघवाणामयुक्तोऽयं कुलस्यास्य विपर्ययः || १-२१-२
translation:
"On promising me to fulfil my object in the first instance you wish to repudiate 
			it now, undeserving is this kind of deviation for the kings of Raghava dynasty. 
			[1-21-2]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
यदीदं ते क्षमं राजन् गमिष्यामि यथागतम् |

			मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञः काकुत्स्थ सुखी भव सबान्धवः || १-२१-३
translation:
"If this is worth while to you, oh, king, I wish to go away as I have come, and 
			you with your feigned promises be nonchalantly happy with your kinsmen." So said 
			Vishvamitra to the king. [1-21-3]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
तस्य रोषपरीतस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः |

			चचाल वसुधा कृत्स्ना विवेश च भयं सुरान् || १-२१-४

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
त्रस्तरूपं तु विज्ञाय जगत्सर्वं महानृषिः |

			नृपतिं सुव्रतो धीरो वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत् || १-२१-५

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले जातः साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः |

			धृतिमान् सुव्रतः श्रीमान्न धर्मं हातुमर्हसि || १-२१-६
translation:
"Born in Ikshwaku dynasty you are apparently the other god of ethics on earth, 
			a staunch one with righteous vows and a glorious one too, such as you are, it 
			will be unapt of you to forsake ethics." [1-21-6]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातो धर्मात्मा इति राघव |

			स्वधर्मं प्रतिपद्यस्व नाधर्मं वोढुमर्हसि || १-२१-७
translation:
"In three worlds you are renowned as the right-minded one, oh, Raghava, hence 
			adhere to your own uprightness, and adhering to unrighteousness will be unapt 
			of you. [1-21-7]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
प्रतिश्रुत्य करिष्येति उक्तं वाक्यमकुर्वतः |

			इष्टापूर्तवधो भूयात्तस्माद्रामं विसर्जय || १-२१-८
translation:
"Promising to effectuate something in any way and not effectuating the given word 
			results in the perdition to the merits of iSTaapuurta 
			Vedic rituals, hence oh, Raghava, leave hold of Rama. [1-21-8]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
कृतास्त्रमकृतास्त्रं वा नैनं शक्ष्यन्ति राक्षसाः |

			गुप्तं कुशिकपुत्रेण ज्वलनेनामृतं यथा || १-२१-९
translation:
"Whether Rama is trained in weaponry or not, demons cannot trounce Rama as long 
			as Kushi's son Vishvamitra protects him, like the heavenly firewall that protects 
			divine nectar. [1-21-9]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
एष विग्रहवान् धर्म एष वीर्यवतां वरः |

			एष बुद्ध्याधिको लोके तपसश्च परायणम् || १-२१-१०
translation:
"He is an embodiment of virtue, matchless among the venturesome, peerless in intellect 
			among all in the world, and flawless in ascesis. [1-21-10]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
एषोऽस्त्रान् विविधान् वेत्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे |

			नैनमन्यः पुमान् वेत्ति न च वेत्स्यन्ति केचन || १-२१-११
translation:
"He is in the know-how of various missiles, and no other person is there in the 
			triad of worlds, inclusive of sessile and mobile worlds, who is knowledgeable 
			about him, or someone who can know him will be there in future, excepting myself. 
			[1-21-11]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
न देवा नर्षयः केचिन्नामरा न च राक्षसाः |

			गन्धर्वयक्षप्रवराः सकिन्नरमहोरगाः || १-२१-१२
translation:
"While Gods cannot know Vishvamitra, can anybody from sages - no; immortals- no; demons 
			- no; the gandharva-s and eminent yaksha-s together with the kinnaraa-s and great 
			reptile beings - no, they cannot know him. [1-21-12]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
सर्वास्त्राणि कृशाश्वस्य पुत्राः परमधार्मिकाः |

			कौशिकाय पुरा दत्ता यदा राज्यं प्रशासति || १-२१-१३
translation:
"All the missiles known to Vishvamitra are the highly righteous children of Krishaashva 
			Prajapati, where Prajapati-s were the earliest ruler of mankind, and god Shiva 
			gave them to Vishvamitra when was ruling kingdom. [1-21-13]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
तेऽपि पुत्रा कृशाश्वस्य प्रजापतिसुतासुताः |

			नैकरूपा महावीर्या दीप्तिमंतो जयावहाः || १-२१-१४
translation:
"Those missiles are the sons of Daksha Prajaapati's daughters and her husband 
			Krishaasva Prajapati, and they are disparate in their form, intrepid, dazzling, 
			and victory-oriented missiles. [1-21-14]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
जया च सुप्रभा चैव दक्षकन्ये सुमध्यमे |

			ते सुवातेऽस्त्रशस्त्राणि शतं परमभास्वरम् || १-२१-१५
translation:
"Jaya and Suprabha, the daughters of Daksha Prajapati, endowed with best waists 
			gave birth to a hundred missiles and weaponry whose flare is supreme. [1-21-15]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
पंचाशतं सुतान् लेभे जया लब्धवरा वरान् | 

            वधायासुरसैन्यानामप्रमेयानरूपिणः || १-२१-१६
translation:
"On getting a boon Jaya named wife of Krishaasva Prajapati is benefited with fifty 
			best and formless sons with immeasurable fortitude for the destruction of ungodly 
			beings. [1-21-16]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
सुप्रभाजनयत् चापि पुत्रान् पंचाशतं पुनः |

			संहारान्नाम दुर्धर्षान् दुराक्रामान् बलीयसः || १-२१-१७
translation:
"Suprabha, another wife of Krishaasva Prajapati, gave birth to another fifty unassailable, 
			unconquerable and mighty sons named the Eliminators. [1-21-17]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
तानि चास्त्राणि वेत्त्येष यथावत् कुशिकात्मजः |

			अपूर्वाणां च जनने शक्तो भूयः स धर्मवित् || १-२१-१८
translation:
"And this sage Vishvamitra is in the precise know of the said missiles, and this 
			principled one is also capable of creating hitherto unavailable missiles. [1-21-18]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
तेनास्य मुनिमुख्यस्य धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मनः |

			न किंचिदस्त्यविदितं भूतं भव्यं च राघव || १-२१-१९
translation:
"Thereby, oh, Raghava, nothing whatsoever is unknown to this great-souled Vishvamitra, 
			who is a distinguished sage and the knower of virtue, either that has happened 
			or that is happening. [1-21-19]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
एवंवीर्यो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महायशाः |

			न रामगमने राजन् संशयं गन्तुमर्हसि || १-२१-२०
translation:
"Thus, the highly renowned and great resplendent sage Vishvamitra has this sort 
			of enterprise, oh, king, allowing a doubt enter your mind in Rama's accompanying 
			the sage will be unapt of you. [1-21-20]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
तेषां निग्रहणे शक्तः स्वयं च कुशिकात्मजः |

			तव पुत्रहितार्थाय त्वामुपेत्याभियाचते || १-२१-२१
translation:
"This son of Kushi, Vishvamitra, can as well control those demons by himself, 
			but intending to accord beneficence to your son he approached you and imploring 
			upon you. [1-21-21]

sargaTitle: Ire of sage vishvamitra; vashiShTha appeases dasharatha
sanskrit:
इति मुनिवचनात् प्रसन्नचित्तो

			रघुवृषभश्च मुमोद पार्थिवाग्र्यः |

			गमनमभिरुरोच राघवस्य

			प्रथितयशाः कुशिकात्मजाय बुद्ध्या || १-२१-२२

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
तथा वसिष्ठे ब्रुवति राजा दशरथः स्वयम् |

			प्रहृष्टवदनो राममाजुहाव सलक्ष्मणम् || १-२२-१

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
कृतस्वस्त्ययनं मात्रा पित्रा दशरथेन च |

			पुरोधसा वसिष्ठेन मङ्गलैरभिमंत्रितम् || १-२२-२

			सपुत्रं मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय राजा दशरथस्तदा |

			ददौ कुशिकपुत्राय सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना || १-२२-३

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
ततो वायुः सुखस्पर्शो नीरजस्को ववौ तदा |

			विश्वामित्रगतं रामं दृष्ट्वा राजीवलोचनम् || १-२२-४

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीद्देवदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनैः |

			शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषः प्रयाते तु महात्मनि || १-२२-५

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रो ययावग्रे ततो रामो महायशाः |

			काकपक्षधरो धन्वी तं च सौमित्रिरन्वगात् || १-२२-६

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
कलापिनौ धनुष्पाणी शोभयानौ दिशो दश |

			विश्वामित्रं महात्मानं त्रिशीर्षाविव पन्नगौ |

			अनुजग्मतुरक्षुद्रौ पितामहमिवाश्विनौ || १-२२-७

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
तदा कुशिकपुत्रं तु धनुष्पाणी स्वलंकृतौ |

			बद्धगोधांगुलित्राणौ खड्गवन्तौ महाद्युती || १-२२-८

			कुमारौ चारुवपुषौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ |

			अनुयातौ श्रिया दीप्तौ शोभयेतामनिन्दितौ || १-२२-९

			स्थाण

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
अध्यर्धयोजनं गत्वा सरय्वा दक्षिणे तटे | १-२२-१०

			रामेति मधुरां वाणीं विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत |

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
गृहाण वत्स सलिलं मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः || १-२२-११

			मंत्रग्रामं गृहाण त्वं बलामतिबलां तथा |
translation:
" "Take water, my boy, and like that you receive a group of hymns,
			bala and atibala from 
			me, and let no time lapse. [1-22-11b, 12a]

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
न श्रमो न ज्वरो वा ते न रूपस्य विपर्ययः || १-२२-१२

			न च सुप्तं प्रमत्तं वा धर्षयिष्यन्ति नैरृताः |
translation:
"On receiving these hymns neither tiredness nor fever, nor disfiguring of personality 
			can effect you, nor the demons can charge you either you are sleeping or unvigilant. 
			[1-11-12b, 13a]

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
न बाह्वोः सदृशो वीर्ये पृथिव्यामस्ति कश्चन || १-२२-१३

			त्रिषु लोकेषु वा राम न भवेत्सदृशस्तव |
translation:
"As it is none whosoever on earth can equal you in dexterity, Rama, and by reciting 
			these hymns none can equal you in the three worlds. [1-22-13b, 14a]

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
बलामतिबलां चैव पठतस्तात राघव || १-२२-१४

			न सौभाग्ये न दाक्षिण्ये न ज्ञाने बुद्धिनिश्चये |

			नोत्तरे प्रतिवक्तव्ये समो लोके तवानघ || १-२२-१५
translation:
"My dear Raghava, if bala atibala hymns are practised, oh, impeccable one, none 
			can equal you in the world by your handsomeness, calibre, erudition, by your discernment, 
			and even in replying or rebutting you. [1-22-14b, 15]

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
एतद्विद्याद्वये लब्धे न भवेत्सदृशस्तव |

			बला चातिबला चैव सर्वज्ञानस्य मातरौ || १-२२-१६
translation:
"On receiving these two teachings there will be none similar to you, for bala 
			and atibala are the mothers of all knowledge. [1-22-16]

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
क्षुत्पिपासे न ते राम भविष्येते नरोत्तम |

			बलामतिबलां चैव पठतस्तात राघव || १-२२-१७
translation:
"Oh, best one among men, Raghava, if you go on reciting bala and atiblala hymns, 
			my dear Rama, there will be no hunger or thirst to you. [1-22-17]

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
गृहाण सर्वलोकस्य गुप्तये रघुनन्दन |

			विद्याद्वयमधीयाने यशश्चाप्यतुलं भुवि |

			पितामहसुते ह्येते विद्ये तेजःसमन्विते || १-२२-१८

			प्रदातुं तव काकुत्स्थ सदृशस्त्वं हि धार्मिक |
translation:
"And if these twin teachings are practised an inestimable renown will also accrue, 
			oh, Raghu's legatee, these two hymns that possess brilliance are the daughters 
			of Forefather Brahma, and oh, Rama of Kakutstha, I intend to impart these hymns 
			to you, oh virtuous one, as you are the most e

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
कामं बहुगुणाः सर्वे त्वय्येते नात्र संशयः |१-२२-१९

			तपसा संभृते चैते बहुरूपे भविष्यतः |
translation:
"Though all of these numerous qualities are undoubtedly available with you, that 
			too in abundance, yet these hymns if ascetically nurtured will yield various results." 
			Thus spoke Sage Vishvamitra to Rama. [1-22-19b, 20a]

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
ततो रामो जलं स्पृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्टवदनः शुचिः | १-२२-२०

			प्रतिजग्राह ते विद्ये महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः |

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
विद्यासमुदितो रामः शुशुभे भूरिविक्रमः || १-२२-२१

			सहस्ररश्मिर्भगवान् शरदीव दिवाकरः |

			गुरुकार्याणि सर्वाणि नियुज्य कुशिकात्मजे |

			ऊषुस्तां रजनीं तत्र सरय्वाः सुसुखं त्रयः || १-२२-२२

sargaTitle: rAma, lakshmaNa travel with vishvamitra to his ritual place
sanskrit:
दशरथनृपसूनुसत्तमाभ्यां

			तृणशयनेऽनुचिते सहोषिताभ्याम् |

			कुशिकसुतवचोऽनुलालिताभ्यां |

			सुखमिव सा विबभौ विभावरी च || १-२२-२३

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः |

अभ्यभाषत काकुत्स्थौ शयानौ पर्णसंस्तरे || १-२३-१

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम पूर्वा संध्या प्रवर्तते |

उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल कर्तव्यं दैवमाह्निकम् || १-२३-२
translation:
"Fortunate is Kausalya to beget you as her son Rama... get up oh, tigerly-man, eastern aurora 
is emerging, daytime tasks towards gods are to be performed." [1-23-2]

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
तस्यर्षेः परमोदारं वचः श्रुत्वा नरोत्तमौ |

स्नात्वा कृतोदकौ वीरौ जेपतुः परमं जपम् || १-२३-३

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
कृताह्निकौ महावीर्यौ विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम् |

अभिवाद्यातिसंहृष्टौ गमनायाभितस्थतुः || १-२३-४

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
तौ प्रयान्तौ महावीर्यौ दिव्यां त्रिपथगां नदीम् |

ददृशाते ततस्तत्र सरय्वाः संगमे शुभे || १-२३-५

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
तत्राश्रमपदं पुण्यं ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् |

बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तप्यतां परमं तपः || १-२३-६

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतौ राघवौ पुण्यमाश्रमम् |

ऊचतुस्तं महात्मानं विश्वामित्रमिदं वचः || १-२३-७

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
कस्यायमाश्रमः पुण्यः को न्वस्मिन्वसते पुमान् |

भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छावः परं कौतूहलं हि नौ || १-२३-८
translation:
"Whose hermitage is this merited one? Indeed who is the celebrity that lives therein? Oh, 
godly sage, we are interested to listen, and we are truly inquisitive about it." Thus they 
asked. [1-23-8]

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
तयोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिपुंगवः |

अब्रवीच्छ्रूयतां राम कस्यायं पूर्व आश्रमः || १-२३-९

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
कन्दर्पो मूर्तिमानासीत् काम इत्युच्यते बुधैः |

तपस्यन्तमिह स्थाणुं नियमेन समाहितम् || १-२३-१०

कृतोद्वाहं तु देवेशं गच्छन्तं समरुद्गणम् |

धर्षयामास दुर्मेधा हुंकृतश्च महात्मना || १-२३-११
translation:
"When Love-god was with his body wise men used to call him Kama, the passion. At this place, 
that Love-god with his naughty intent braved god of gods Shiva who had been practising ascesis 
and who concentrated observantly, and who was returning after his marriage along with his 
followers, namely t

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
अवध्यतश्च रौद्रेण चक्षुषा रघुनन्दन |

व्यशीर्यन्त शरीरात् स्वात् सर्वगात्राणि दुर्मतेः || १-२३-१२
translation:
"And Rama, the wrathful third-eye of Shiva destroyed the lewd-minded Love-god making all his 
limbs to fall down from his body. [1-23-12]

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
तत्र गात्रं हतं तस्य निर्दग्धस्य महात्मनः |

अशरीरः कृतः कामः क्रोधाद्देवेश्वरेण ह || १-२३-१३
translation:
"There the body of Love-god is evanesced when that great soul Shiva burnt it down, and by 
the anger of that god of gods Shiva, Love-god is rendered as a bodiless entity. [1-23-13]

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
अनङ्ग इति विख्यातस्तदाप्रभृति राघव |

स चाङ्गविषयः श्रीमान् यत्राङ्गं स मुमोच ह || १-२३-१४

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
तस्यायमाश्रमः पुण्यस्तस्येमे मुनयः पुरा |

शिष्या धर्मपरा वीर तेषां पापं न विद्यते || १-२३-१५
translation:
"This merited hermitage thus belongs to Shiva and, oh, brave Rama, these sages abiding in 
virtue are Shiva's disciples at one time, thus sin is unverifiable with them. [1-23-15]

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
इहाद्य रजनीं राम वसेम शुभदर्शन |

पुण्ययोः सरितोर्मध्ये श्वस्तरिष्यामहे वयम् || १-२३-१६
translation:
"Let us stay for this night in this hermitage situated in between two meritorious rivers Ganga 
and Sarayu, oh, Rama with auspicious mien, tomorrow we will cross over the River Ganga. [1-23-16]

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
अभिगच्छामहे सर्वे शुचयः पुण्यमाश्रमम् |

इह वासः परोऽस्माकं सुखं वस्त्यामहे वयम् || १-२३-१७

स्नाताश्च कृतजप्याश्च हुतहव्या नरोत्तम |
translation:
"Let us all purify ourselves by taking our bath, performing our meditations, offering our 
daily oblations, and then let us enter this meritorious hermitage, thus our stay in here will 
be comforting to us." So said Vishvamitra to Rama and Lakshmana. [1-23-17, 18a]

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
तेषां संवदतां तत्र तपोदीर्घेण चक्षुषा || १-२३-१८

विज्ञाय परमप्रीता मुनयो हर्षमागमन् |

अर्घ्यं पाद्यं तथातिथ्यं निवेद्य कुशिकात्मजे || १-२३-१९

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
रामलक्ष्मणयोः पश्चादकुर्वन्नतिथिक्रियाम् |

सत्कारं समनुप्राप्य कथाभिरभिरंजयन् ||१-२३-२०

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
यथार्हमजपन् संध्यामृषयस्ते समाहिताः |

तत्र वासिभिरानीता मुनिभिः सुव्रतैः सह || १-२३-२१

न्यवसन् सुसुखं तत्र कामाश्रमपदे तथा |

sargaTitle: Their sojourn at the confluence of the rivers ganga and sarayu
sanskrit:
कथाभिरभिरामभिरभिरामौ नृपात्मजौ | - 

रमयामास धर्मात्मा कौशिको मुनिपुङ्गवः || १-२३-२२

ततः प्रभाते विमले कृताह्निकमरिन्दमौ |

विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य नद्यास्तीरमुपागतौ || १-२४-१

ते च सर्वे महात्मानो मुनयः संश्रितव्रताः |

उपस्थाप्य शुभां नावं विश्वामित्रमथाब्रुवन् || १-२४-२

आरोहतु भवान्नावं राजपुत्रपुरस्कृतः |

अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानं मा भूत्कालविपर्ययः || १-२४-३
translation:
"You may board the boat keeping the princes ahead of you, and we wish you to proceed on a 
prosperous route without the shift of time." So said the sages. [1-24-3]

sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रस्तथेत्युक्त्वा तानृषीन्प्रतिपूज्य च |

ततार सहितस्ताभ्यां सरितं सागरंगमाम् || १-२४-४

तत्र शुश्राव वै शब्दं तोयसंरम्भवर्धितम् |

मध्यमागम्य तोयस्य तस्य शब्दस्य निश्चयम् || १-२४-५

ज्ञातुकामो महातेजा सह रामः कनीयसा |

अथ रामः सरिन्मध्ये पप्रच्छ मुनिपुङ्गवम् || १-२४-६

वारिणो भिद्यमानस्य किमयं तुमुलो ध्वनिः |

राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम् || १-२४-७

कथयामास धर्मात्मा तस्य शब्दस्य निश्चयम् |

कैलासपर्वते राम मनसा निर्मितं परम् || १-२४-८

ब्रह्मणा नरशार्दूल तेनेदं मानसं सरः |
translation:
"On Mt. Kailash Brahma created a great lake at his will, oh, tigerly-man Rama, hence that 
is called Maanasa Lake. [1-24-8b, 9a]

sanskrit:
तस्मात् सुस्राव सरसः सायोध्यामुपगूहते || १-२४-९

सरः प्रवृत्ता सरयूः पुण्या ब्रह्मसरश्च्युता |

तस्यायमतुलः शब्दो जाह्नवीमभिवर्तते || १-२४-१०

वारिसंक्षोभजो राम प्रणामं नियतः कुरु |
translation:
"That river which spontaneously flows out of that Maanasa Lake surrounds Ayodhya city is this 
one, the River Sarayu. Because this has originated from a lake, saraH, 
this is known as Sarayu. And because it flows from Brahma's Lake it is a merited river. This 
is the remarkable noise of such a Saray

sanskrit:
ताभ्यां तु तावुभौ कृत्वा प्रणाममतिधार्मिकौ || १-२४-११

तीरं दक्षिणमासाद्य जग्मतुर्लघुविक्रमौ |

स वनं घोरसंकाशं दृष्ट्वा नरवरात्मजः || १-२४-१२

अविप्रहतमैक्ष्वाकः पप्रच्छ मुनिपुंगवम् |

अहो वनमिदं दुर्गं झिल्लिकागणसंयुतम् || १-२४-१३

भैरवैः श्वापदैः कीर्णं शकुनैर्दारुणारवैः |
translation:
"Oh, impenetrable is this forest fraught with swarms of crickets, brutish predators, and vultures, 
which are all horribly strident. [1-24-13b, 14a]

sanskrit:
नानाप्रकारैः शकुनैर्वाश्यद्भिर्भैरवस्वनैः || १-२४-१४

सिंहव्याघ्रवराहैश्च वारणैश्चापि शोभितम् |
translation:
"Various vultures are screeching with fierce sonority, and tigers, wild boars, and elephants 
render this forest atypical. [1-24-14b, 15a]

sanskrit:
धवाश्वकर्णककुभैर्बिल्वतिन्दुकपाटलैः || १-२४-१५

संकीर्णं बदरीभिश्च किंन्वेतद्दारुणं वनम् |
translation:
"Indeed, what is this wretched forest that is dense with Dhava, Ashvakarna, Arjuna, Bilva, 
Tinduka, Patala, and Badari trees." Thus Rama asked Vishvamitra. [1-24-15b, 16a]

sanskrit:
तमुवाच महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः || १-२४-१६

श्रूयतां वत्स काकुत्स्थ यस्यैतद्दारुणं वनम् |

एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ पूर्वमास्तां नरौत्तम || १-२४-१७

मलदाश्च करूषाश्च देवनिर्माणनिर्मितौ |
translation:
"Once these were vast provinces, oh, best one among men, designed by gods and known as Malada 
and Karuusha. [1-24-17b, 18a]

sanskrit:
पुरा वृत्रवधे राम मलेन समभिप्लुतम् || १-२४-१८

क्षुधा चैव सहस्राक्षं ब्रह्महत्या समाविशत् |
translation:
"Once upon a time, oh, Rama, mortal impurities of filth and hunger completely stained Indra 
when he eliminated demon Vritra, as he committed the sin of killing of a Brahman, where the 
demon Vritra was incidentally a Brahman. [1-24-18b, 19a]

sanskrit:
तमिन्द्रं मलिनं देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः || १-२४-१९

कलशैः स्नापयामासुर्मलं चास्य प्रमोचयन् |
translation:
"The gods and ascetically rich sages then started to bathe feculent Indra with their handy 
vessels for the riddance of his defilement. [1-24-19b, 20a]

sanskrit:
इह भूम्यां मलं दत्त्वा देवाः कारूषमेव च || १-२४-२०

शरीरजं महेन्द्रस्य ततो हर्षं प्रपेदिरे |
translation:
"On giving filth and hunger emerged out of the body of Mahendra here on the earth then the 
gods were gladdened. [1-24-20b, 21a]

sanskrit:
निर्मलो निष्करूषश्च शुचिरिन्द्रो यथाभवत् || १-२४-२१

ततो देशस्य सुप्रीतो वरं प्रादादनुत्तमम् |
translation:
"As and when Indra was without desecration and hunger as well, and thus purified, then gladdened 
about this place he gave it an unexcelled boon. [1-24-21b, 22a]

sanskrit:
इमौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यतः || १-२४-२२

मलदाश्च करूषाश्च ममांगमलधारिणौ |
translation:
"These provinces that bear the impurity of my body shall become resourceful and they shall 
attain renown in world as Malada and Karusha." Thus Indra gave boon to this place. [1-24-22b, 
23a]

sanskrit:
साधु साध्विति तं देवाः पाकशासनमब्रुवन् || १-२४-२३

देशस्य पूजां तां दृष्ट्वा कृतां शक्रेण धीमता |
translation:
"On observing the honour accorded by wise Indra to these places gods praised the controller 
of demon Paaka, namely Indra saying, 'splendid, splendid it is.' [1-24-23b, 24a]

sanskrit:
एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ दीर्घकालमरिन्दम || १-२४-२४

मलदाश्च करूषाश्च मुदितौ धनधान्यतः |
translation:
"For a long time these habitations Malada and Karuusha were affluent, oh, enemy subjugator 
Rama, and people were happy with wealth and provisions. [1-24-24b, 25a]

sanskrit:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य यक्षी वै कामरूपिणी || १-२४-२५

बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयन्ती तदा ह्यभूत् |

ताटका नाम भद्रं ते भार्या सुन्दस्य धीमतः || १-२४-२६

मारीचो राक्षसः पुत्रो यस्याः शक्रपराक्रमः |
translation:
"Later at sometime, a yaksha female who is a guise changer at her wish, possessor of the strength 
of a thousand elephants, wife of clever Sunda, and she whose son is demon Mareecha, the 
one equal to Indra in his bravery, prevailed here, let you be safe Rama. [1-24-25b, 26, 27a]

sanskrit:
वृत्तबाहुर्महाशीर्षो विपुलास्यतनुर्महान् || १-२४-२७

राक्षसो भैरवाकारो नित्यं त्रासयते प्रजाः |
translation:
"That demon Mareecha is round shouldered, huge headed, cavernous mouthed, and gigantic bodied 
one, and he is always terrifying the people. [1-24-27b, 28a]

sanskrit:
इमौ जनपदौ नित्यं विनाशयति राघव || १-२४-२८

मलदांश्च करूषांश्च ताटका दुष्टचारिणी |
translation:
"And Raghava, that malevolent Tataka is always destroying the inhabitations at Malada and 
Karusha. [1-24-28b, 29a]

sanskrit:
सेयं पन्थानमावृत्य वसत्यध्यर्धयोजने || १-२४-२९

अतैव च गन्तव्यं ताटकाया वनं यतः |
translation:
"She lives about one and half yojana distance from here, and by which reason this became the 
forest of Tataka, owing to her gruesome activities, for that reason only a headway is to be 
made, to eradicate her and her activities. [1-24-29b, 30a]

sanskrit:
स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य जहीमां दुष्टचारिणीम् || १-२४-३०

मन्नियोगादिमं देशं कुरु निष्कण्टकं पुनः |
translation:
"Depending upon the strength of your own self-confidence you have to eradicate this evildoer, 
and assigned by me you have to make this province free from thorniness. [1-24-30b, 31a]

sanskrit:
न हि कश्चिदिमं देशं शक्तो ह्यागन्तुमीदृशम् || १-२४-३१

यक्षिण्या घोरया राम उत्सादितमसह्यया |
translation:
"Indeed, none is able to enter this sort of province, Rama, destroyed by the hazardous 
and invincible unearthly being who turned into a demoness, namely Tataka, hence you have to 
make the provinces habitable. [1-24-31b, 32a]

sanskrit:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथैतद्दारुणं वनम् |

यक्ष्या चोत्सादितं सर्वमद्यापि न निवर्तते || १-२४-३२
translation:
"As to how that ghoulish Tataka destroyed this entire forest, rendering it as a devastated 
place, without refraining from it even today, all that is narrated." So said Vishvamitra to 
Rama. [1-24-32]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
अथ तस्याप्रमेयस्य मुनेर्वचनमुत्तमम् |

श्रुत्वा पुरुषशार्दूलः प्रत्युवाच शुभां गिरम् || १-२५-१

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
अल्पवीर्या यदा यक्षी श्रूयते मुनिपुङ्गव |

कथं नागसहस्रस्य धारयत्यबला बलम् || १-२५-२
translation:
"It is said that yaksha's strength is trivial, and this is an yakshii, more so a female, how 
then this yakshii frail by her femineity can exert the strength of a thousand elephants? [1-25-2]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
इत्युक्तं वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्यामितोजसा |

हर्षयन् श्लक्ष्णया वाचा सलक्ष्मणमरिन्दमम् || १-२५-३

विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं शृणु येन बलोत्कटा |

वरदानकृतं वीर्यं धारयत्यबला बलम् || १-२५-४

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
पूर्वमासीन्महायक्षः सुकेतुर्नाम वीर्यवान् |

अनपत्यः शुभाचारः स च तेपे महत्तपः || १-२५-५
translation:
"Once there was a formidable yaksha named Suketu, but he was childless, and he who had devout 
conduct performed a great ascesis. [1-25-5]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
पितामहस्तु सुप्रीतस्तस्य यक्षपतेस्तदा |

कन्यारत्नं ददौ राम ताटकां नाम नामतः || १-२५-६
translation:
"Gladdening at his ascesis, Rama, then the Forefather Brahma gave him a gemlike daughter who 
is renowned by the name of Tataka. [1-25-6]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
ददौ नागसहस्रस्य बलं चास्याः पितामहः |

न त्वेव पुत्रं यक्षाय ददौ ब्रह्मा महायशाः || १-२५-७
translation:
"Forefather Brahma also gave the strength of a thousand elephants to her, but he that highly 
remarkable Brahma did not give a son to that yaksha, anticipating male to be more hazardous. 
[1-25-7]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
तां तु बालां विवर्धन्तीं रूपयौवनशालिनीम् |

जंभपुत्राय सुन्दाय ददौ भार्यां यशस्विनीम् || १-२५-८
translation:
"When that bright girl is growing up into a youthful beauty her father Suketu gave her to 
Jambha's son Sunda as wife. [1-25-8]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य यक्षी पुत्रं व्यजायत |

मारीचं नाम दुर्धर्षं यः शापाद्राक्षसोऽभवत् ||१-२५-९
translation:
"Then after sometime that yakshii Tataka delivered an indomitable son named Mareecha, who 
by curse became a demon. [1-25-9]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
सुन्दे तु निहते राम सागस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम् |

ताटका सह पुत्रेण प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति || १-२५-१०
translation:
"But when Sunda is eliminated by sage Agastya's curse, she that Tataka wished to retaliate 
that eminent sage along with her son Mareecha. [1-25-10]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
भक्षार्थं जातसंरम्भा गर्जन्ती साभ्यधावत |

आपतन्तीं तु तां दृष्ट्वा अगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः || १-२५-११

राक्षसत्वं भजस्वेति मारीचं व्याजहार सः |
translation:
"With desperation brewing in her she roaringly rushed towards the sage as though to eat him 
away, and on seeing her rushing along with her son Mareecha towards him, the godly saint Agastya 
firstly cursed Mareecha saying, 'you will attain demon-hood.' [1-25-11, 12a]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
अगस्त्यः परमामर्षस्ताटकामपि शप्तवान् || १-२५-१२

पुरुषादी महायक्षी विरूपा विकृतानना |

इदं रूपं विहायाशु दारुणं रूपमस्तु ते || १-२५-१३
translation:
"Highly infuriated sage Agastya even cursed Tataka saying, 'forthwith divested of this form 
of a beautiful female, oh, great yakshii, you shall become a man eater with your form distorted, 
face contorted, and shape monstrous.' [1-25-12b, 13]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
सैषा शापकृतामर्षा ताटका क्रोधमूर्च्छिता |

देशमुत्सादयत्येनमगस्त्याचरितं शुभम् || १-२५-१४
translation:
"Frenzied by the curse and convulsed in fury she that Tataka is thus vandalising this auspicious 
province, in which sage Agastya once sauntered. [1-25-14]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
एनां राघवदुर्वृत्तां यक्षीं परमदारुणाम् |

गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय जहि दुष्टपराक्रमाम् || १-२५-१५
translation:
"She that highly atrocious one is with horrific behaviour and malefic valour, hence you shall 
eliminate this yakshii for the welfare of Brahmans and cows. [1-25-15]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
न ह्येनां शापसंसृष्टां कश्चिदुत्सहते पुमान् |

निहन्तुं त्रिषु लोकेषु त्वामृते रघुनन्दन || १-२५-१६
translation:
"Excepting you there is none to eliminate her who is indomitably sheathed in a curse, oh, 
Raghu's legatee, and none in the three worlds can possibly brave her. [1-25-16]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
न हि ते स्त्रीवधकृते घृणा कार्या नरोत्तम |

चातुर्वर्ण्यहितार्थाय कर्तव्यम् राजसूनुना || १-२५-१७
translation:
"Compassion regarding the elimination of a female is ungermane, oh, best one among men, since 
a prince has to effectuate it intending the welfare of four categories of society. [1-25-17]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
नृशंसमनृशंसं वा प्रजारक्षणकारणात् |

पातकं वा सदोषं वा कर्तव्यं रक्षता सदा || १-२५-१८
translation:
"For the reason of protecting people, a protector always has to execute such deed, either 
it is ruthless or humane, sinful or vilifying. [1-25-18]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
राज्यभारनियुक्तानामेष धर्मः सनातनः |

अधर्म्यां जहि काकुत्स्थ धर्मो ह्यस्यां न विद्यते || १-२५-१९
translation:
"To the nominee who bears the burden of kingdom this is the age-old duty, and hence oh, Rama, 
the legatee of Kakutstha, eliminate this infamy, as goodness is inevident in her, isn't it. 
[1-25-19]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
श्रूयते हि पुरा शक्रो विरोचनसुतां नृप |

पृथिवीं हन्तुमिच्छन्तीं मन्थरामभ्यसूदयत् || १-२५-२०
translation:
"Oh, Rama, the protector of people, we have heard that Indra once eliminated Manthara, the 
daughter of Virochana, when she wished to annihilate earth, haven't we. [1-25-20]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
विष्णुना च पुरा राम भृगुपत्नी पतिव्रता |

अनिन्द्रं लोकमिच्छन्ती काव्यमाता निषूदिता || १-२५-२१
translation:
"And Rama, once Vishnu wiped out even the wife of sage Bhrigu and sage Shukracarya's mother 
when she wished the world to become one without a governing factor, namely Indra. [1-25-21]

sargaTitle: The legend of deomoness tATaka - contd
sanskrit:
एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभी राजपुत्रैर्महात्मभिः |

अधर्मसहिता नार्यो हताः पुरुषसत्तमैः |

तस्मादेनां घृणां त्यक्त्वा जहि मच्छासनान्नृप || १-२५-२२
translation:
"Oh, prince, these great souls and many other celebrated personalities have eliminated females 
who deported themselves with unrighteousness, and hence, oh, Rama, the protector of people, 
by my decree you leave off compassion and eliminate her." Thus said sage Vishvamitra to Rama 
regarding Tataka'

sanskrit:
मुनेर्वचनमक्लीबं श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मजः |

राघवः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच दृढव्रतः || १-२६-१

पितुर्वचननिर्देशात् पितुर्वचनगौरवात् |

वचनं कौशिकस्येति कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया || १-२६-२
translation:
"Upon my father's order, upon my honour to my father's word, and looking upon this 
as the word of sage Kushi's son, my mentor, this task is definitely to be implemented. 
[1-26-2]

sanskrit:
अनुशिष्टोऽस्म्ययोध्यायां गुरुमध्ये महात्मना |

पित्रा दशरथेनाहं नावज्ञेयं च तद्वचः || १-२६-३
translation:
"What my great souled father Dasharatha directed me to do among elders in Ayodhya, 
that word too cannot be disregarded. [1-26-3]

sanskrit:
सोऽहं पितुर्वचः श्रुत्वा शासनाद्ब्रह्मवादिनः |

करिष्यामि न संदेहस्ताटकावधमुत्तमम् || १-२६-४
translation:
"Such as I am, I will undertake the primary duty of eliminating Tataka, according 
as the follower of father's words, and according to the instruction of a Brahma 
scholar, such as your are, without a doubt. [1-26-4]

sanskrit:
गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय देशस्यास्य हिताय च |

तव चैवाप्रमेयस्य वचनं कर्तुमुद्यतः || १-२६-५
translation:
"I am ready to effectuate the bidding of an inestimable sage like you, for the welfare 
of cows and Brahmans, and for the advantage of this province." So said Rama to sage 
Vishvamitra. [1-26-5]

sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा धनुर्मध्ये बध्वा मुष्टिमरिन्दमः |

ज्याघोषमकरोत्तीव्रं दिशः शब्देन नादयन् || १-२६-६

तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तास्ताटकावनवासिनः |

ताटका च सुसंक्रुद्धा तेन शब्देन मोहिता || १-२६-७

तं शब्दमभिनिध्याय राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्च्छिता |

श्रुत्वा चाभ्यद्रवत् क्रुद्धा यतः शब्दो विनिस्सृतः || १-२६-८

तां दृष्ट्वा राघवः क्रुद्धां विकृतां विकृताननाम् |

प्रमाणेनातिवृद्धां च लक्ष्मणं सोऽभ्यभाषत || १-२६-९

पश्य लक्ष्मण यक्षिण्या भैरवं दारुणं वपुः |

भिद्येरन् दर्शनादस्या भीरूणां हृदयानि च || १-२६-१०
translation:
"Lakshmana, see that yakshii's grisly and ghastly physique, seeing which hearts 
of cowards are prone to burst. [1-26-10]

sanskrit:
एतां पश्य दुराधर्षां मायाबलसमन्विताम् |

विनिवृत्तां करोम्यद्य हृतकर्णाग्रनासिकाम् || १-२६-११
translation:
" She is unstoppable and has magical powers, is't, you may see now how I will make 
her to readily retreat by lopping off her ears and the tip of nose. [1-26-11]

sanskrit:
न ह्येनामुत्सहे हन्तुं स्त्रीस्वभावेन रक्षिताम् |

वीर्यं चास्या गतिं चापि हन्यतामिति मे मतिः || १-२६-१२
translation:
"As it is her femininess is protecting her, and I too I do not really attempt 
to kill her, but I intend to terminate her impudence and mobility. [1-26-12]

sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवाणे रामे तु ताटका क्रोधमूर्च्छिता |

उद्यम्य बाहू गर्जन्ती राममेवाभ्यधावत || १-२६-१३

विश्वामित्रस्तु ब्रह्मर्षिर्हुंकारेणाभिभर्त्स्य ताम् |

स्वस्ति राघवयोरस्तु जयं चैवाभ्यभाषत || १-२६-१४

उद्धुन्वाना रजो घोरं ताटका राघवावुभौ |

रजो मेघेन महता मुहूर्तं सा व्यमोहयत् || १-२६-१५

ततो मायां समास्थाय शिलावर्षेण राघवौ |

अवाकिरत् सुमहता ततश्चुक्रोध राघवः || १-२६-१६

शिलावर्षं महत्तस्याः शरवर्षेण राघवः |

प्रतिवार्योपधावन्त्याः करौ चिच्छेद पत्रिभिः || १-२६-१७

ततश्च्छिन्नभुजां श्रान्तामभ्याशे परिगर्जतीम् |

सौमित्रिरकरोत् क्रोधाद् हृतकर्णाग्रनासिकाम् || १-२६-१८

कामरूपधरा सा तु कृत्वा रूपाण्यनेकशः |

अन्तर्धानं गता यक्षी मोहयन्ती स्वमायया || १-२६-१९

अश्मवर्षं विमुंचन्ती भैरवं विचचार सा ||

ततस्तावश्मवर्षेण कीर्यमाणौ समन्ततः || १-२६-२०

दृष्ट्वा गाधिसुतः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् |

अलं ते घृणया राम पापैषा दुष्टचारिणी || १-२६-२१

यज्ञविघ्नकरी यक्षी पुरा वर्धेत मायया |
translation:
"Enough is your compassion Rama, she is a sinister, behaviourally malevolent, a 
hinderer of rituals, and this yakshii gets a grip on herself in a short time by 
her illusory powers. [1-26-21b, 22a]

sanskrit:
वध्यतां तावदेवैषा पुरा संध्या प्रवर्तते || १-२६-२२

रक्षांसि संध्याकाले तु दुर्धर्षाणि भवन्ति हि |
translation:
"Sun is going to set in a short time, and only before that time she shall be destroyed, 
for demons at dusk and afterwards become unassailable, indeed." So said sage Viswamitra 
to Rama. [1-26-22b, 23a]

sanskrit:
इत्युक्तस्स तु तां यक्षीमश्मवृष्ट्याभिवर्षिणीम् || १-२६-२३

दर्शयन् शब्दवेधित्वं तां रुरोध स सायकैः |

सा रुद्धा बाणजालेन मायाबलसमन्विता || १-२६-२४

अभिदुद्राव काकुत्स्थं लक्षमणं च विनेषुदी ||

तामापतन्तीं वेगेन विक्रान्तामशनीमिव || १-२६-२५

शरेणोरसि विव्याध सा पपात ममार च |

तां हतां भीमसंकाशां दृष्ट्वा सुरपतिस्तदा || १-२६-२६

साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थं सुराश्चाप्यभिपूजयन् |

उवाच परमप्रीतः सहस्राक्षः पुरन्दरः || १-२६-२७

सुराश्च सर्वे संहृष्टा विश्वामित्रमथाब्रुवन् |

मुने कौशिक भद्रं ते सेन्द्राः सर्वे मरुद्गणाः || १-२६-२८

तोषिताः कर्मणानेन स्नेहं दर्शय राघवे |
translation:
"Oh, sage Vishvamitra, you are blessed, all the groups of wind-gods along with Indra 
are pleased, so you please show more concern for Raghava. [1-26-28b, 29a]

sanskrit:
प्रजापतेः कृशाश्वस्य पुत्रान्सत्यपराक्रमान् || १-२६-२९

तपोबलभृतो ब्रह्मन् राघवाय निवेदय |
translation:
"The sons of Prajapati Krishasva who are valiant by their virtue and who possess 
ascetic strength, oh, Brahman, they may be offered to Raghava. [1-26-29b, 30a]

sanskrit:
पात्रभूतश्च ते ब्रह्मंस्तवानुगमने रतः || १-२६-३०

कर्तव्यं सुमहत्कर्म सुराणां राजसूनुना |
translation:
"Rama is steadfast in following your assignments and thus he is the worthy receiver 
of those missiles, and this prince has to accomplish a very great deed of gods. 
So said gods to Vishvamitra. [1-26-30b, 31a]

sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे जग्मुर्हृष्टा विहायसम् || १-२६-३१

विश्वामित्रं पूजयन्तस्ततः संध्या प्रवर्तते |

ततो मुनिवरः प्रीतस्ताटकावधतोषितः || १-२६-३२

मूर्ध्नि राममुपाघ्राय इदं वचनमब्रवीत् |

इहाद्य रजनीं राम वसेम शुभदर्शन || १-२६-३३

श्वः प्रभाते गमिष्यामस्तदाश्रमपदं मम |
translation:
"Here we stay for tonight, Rama, the august one for a gaze, and tomorrow morning 
we will go to that hermitage of mine. So said Vishvamitra to Rama. [1-26-33b, 34a]

sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा हृष्टो दशरथात्मजः || १-२६-३४

उवास रजनीं तत्र ताटकाया वने सुखम् |

मुक्तशापं वनं तच्च तस्मिन्नेव तदाहनि |

रमणीयं विबभ्राज यथा चैत्ररथं वनम् || १-२६-३५

निहत्य तां यक्षसुतां स रामः

प्रशस्यमानः सुरसिद्धसङ्घैः |

उवास तस्मिन्मुनिना सहैव

प्रभातवेलां प्रतिबोध्यमानः || १-२६-३६

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
अथ तां रजनीमुष्य विश्वामित्रो महायशाः |

			प्रहस्य राघवं वाक्यमुवाच मधुराक्षरम् || १-२७-१

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
परितुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते राजपुत्र महायशः |

			प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो ददाम्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः || १-२७-२
translation:
"I am highly pleased with you, oh, illustrious prince Rama, let safety 
			be with you, I will now give you all of the divine missiles in utmost 
			fondness of mine. [1-27-2]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
देवासुरगणान् वापि सगन्धर्वोरगान्भुवि |

			यैरमित्रान् प्रसह्याजौ वशीकृत्य जयिष्यसि || १-२७-३

			तानि दिव्यानि भद्रं ते ददाम्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः |
translation:
"I am going to accord all of those divine missiles by which scores of 
			gods, demons, or even from gandharva-s, uragaa-s and the like, or even 
			earthlings are dominated, humbled down and conquered in war. Let safety 
			be with you. [1-27-3, 4a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
दण्डचक्रं महद्दिव्यं तव दास्यामि राघव || १-२७-४

			धर्मचक्रं ततो वीर कालचक्रं तथैव च |

			विष्णुचक्रं तथात्युग्रमैन्द्रं चक्रं तथैव च || १-२७-५

			वज्रमस्त्रं नरश्रेष्ठ शैवं शूलवरं तथा |

			अस्त्र
translation:
"Raghava, I am going to give the highly divine Danda disc [Punisher 
			disc]; next, oh, best one among men, Dharma disc [Virtue-disc,] and 
			like that kaala disc [Time-disc]; then oh, brave one, Vishnu disc; similarly 
			oh, dextrous Rama, Indra disc and Thunderbolt missile; the best trident

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
गदे द्वे चैव काकुत्स्थ मोदकी शिखरी शुभे || १-२७-७

			प्रदीप्ते नरशार्दूल प्रयच्छामि नृपात्मज |
translation:
"Oh manly tiger prince Rama, I am going to accord two maces that are 
			brilliant by their radiance called, the Modaki, [the Beater,] and Shikhari, 
			[the Tower of Protection.] [1-27-7b, 8a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
धर्मपाशमहं राम कालपाशं तथैव च || १-२७-८

			वारुणं पाशमस्त्रं च ददाम्यहमनुत्तमम् |
translation:
"Oh, Rama, like that I will be giving three nooses called Dharma paasha 
			and kaala-paasha and Varuna paasha, [Virtue noose and Time noose, Rain 
			god's noose] as well as an unequalled missile called Varuna astra, Rain-god's 
			missile. [1-27-8b, 9a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
अशनी द्वे प्रयच्छामि शुष्कार्द्रे रघुनन्दन || १-२७-९

			ददामि चास्त्रं पैनाकमस्त्रं नारायणं तथा |
translation:
"Oh, Raghu's scion, I will also give two projectile bolts, one called 
			shushka [The Drier] and the other aardra [The Drencher] and even 
			the missiles of Pinaaka and that of Narayana, [the missiles of god Shiva 
			and Narayana] I will give. [1-27-9b, 10a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
आग्नेयमस्त्रं दयितं शिखरं नाम नामतः || १-२७-१०

			वायव्यं प्रथमं नाम ददामि तव चानघ |
translation:
"Oh, impeccable Rama, thus a well-known missile shikhari [The Tower] 
			and another the fond of Fire-god known as prathama [The Blower] and 
			a missile of Air-god too, I will be giving. [1-27-10b, 11a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
अस्त्रं हयशिरो नाम क्रौञ्चमस्त्रं तथैव च || १-२७-११

			शक्तिद्वयं च काकुत्स्थ ददामि तव राघव |
translation:
"Oh, Raghava of Kakutstha-s, I will give you two missiles named Haya-shira 
			[The Horse-head] and Krouncha [The Wrester] and two Impellers, one 
			presided over by the power of Vishnu, and the other by the power of 
			Rudra. [1-27-11b, 12a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
कंकालं मुसलं घोरं कापालमथ किङ्किणीम् || १-२७-१२

			वधार्थं रक्षसां यानि ददाम्येतानि सर्वशः |
translation:
"I will be giving all those weapons that are wielded by demons, namely 
			the deadly Pounder named Kankaalam, and Rods named as Kapaalam and Kankanam, 
			for the elimination of those very demons. [1-27-12b, 13a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
वैद्याधरं महास्त्रं च नन्दनं नाम नामतः || १-२७-१३

			असिरत्नं महाबाहो ददामि नृवरात्मज |
translation:
"Oh, mighty armed son of the best king, I am giving a great missile 
			named Vaidyadhara by its name, and a gem of sword named Nandana. [1-27-13b, 
			14a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
गान्धर्वमस्त्रं दयितं मोहनं नाम नामतः || १-२७-१४

			प्रस्वापनं प्रशमनं दद्मि सौम्यं च राघव |
translation:
"Thus, the missile which is very much liked by Gandharva-s, namely Mohana, 
			[The Stupefier,] the missile called Prasvapana [The Inducer of Sleep,] 
			and the gentle Prashamana [The Pacifier of enemy's anger.] [1-27-14b, 
			15a]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
वर्षणं शोषणं चैव संतापनविलापने || १-२७-१५

			मादनं चैव दुर्धर्षं कन्दर्पदयितं तथा |

			गान्धर्वमस्त्रं दयितं मानवं नाम नामतः || १-२७-१६

			पैशाचमस्त्रं दयितं मोहनं नाम नामतः |

			प्रतीच्छ नरशार्दू
translation:
"Oh, highly fortunate Rama, take these missiles namely, varshaNa, [the 
			Rainer,] shoshana [the Drainer,] santaapana [the Humidifier,] vilaapana 
			[the Weep-inducer,] and oh, prince, an unassailable intoxicator and 
			a dear missile of Manmatha, namely Mohana [The Intoxicator,] and another

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
तामसं नरशार्दूल सौमनं च महाबलम् |

			संवर्तं चैव दुर्धर्षं मौसलं च नृपात्मज || १-२७-१८

			सत्यमस्त्रं महाबाहो तथा मायामयं परम् |

			सौरं तेजःप्रभं नाम परतेजोऽपकर्षणम् || १-२७-१९

			सोमास्त्रं शिशि
translation:
"Oh, manly-tiger Rama, greatly powered taamasa and saumana missiles, 
			the indomitable missiles like samvarta, mausala, satya, and then the 
			maaya-maya missile; like that oh, mighty armed Rama, a solar missile 
			the sequestrator of others' brilliance namely teja-prabha; next, the 
			missile

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
एतान् राम महाबाहो कामरूपान् महाबलान् |

			गृहाण परमोदारान् क्षिप्रमेव नृपात्मज || १-२७-२१
translation:
"These missiles are, oh, dextrous prince, disguise-wizards, greatly 
			powered, and highly providential ones, oh, Rama, you may take them forthwith." 
			So said sage Vishvamitra to Rama. [1-27-21]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
स्थितस्तु प्राङ्मुखो भूत्वा मुनिवरस्तदा |

			ददौ रामाय सुप्रीतो मंत्रग्राममनुत्तमम् || १-२७-२२

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
सर्वसंग्रहणं येषां दैवतैरपि दुर्लभम् |

			तान्यस्त्राणि तदा विप्रो राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ||१-२७-२३

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
जपतस्तु मुनेस्तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः |

			उपतस्थुर्महार्हाणि सर्वाण्यस्त्राणि राघवम् || १-२७-२४

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
ऊचुश्च मुदिता रामं सर्वे प्रांजलयस्तदा |

			इमे च परमोदाराः किंकरास्तव राघव || १-२७-२५

			यद्यदिच्छसि भद्रं ते तत्सर्वं करवाम वै |

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
ततो रामः प्रसन्नात्मा तैरित्युक्तो महाबलैः || १-२७-२६

			प्रतिगृह्य च काकुत्स्थः समालभ्य च पाणिना |

			मनसा मे भविष्यध्वमिति तानभ्यचोदयत् || १-२७-२७

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra endows rAma with supernatural missiles
sanskrit:
ततः प्रीतमना रामो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम् |

			अभिवाद्य महातेजा गमनायोपचक्रमे || १-२७-२८
translation:
"It contains air, fire and cosmic poison, 
two goat-like fangs, full of poison, weighty, emits air, contains mercury, fiery, 
sparkling, sky is filled with air, enemy-killing, greatly radiant and it is projected 
with three hymns, Gayatri at its centre, it is known as brahma-astra

sanskrit:

			गच्छन्नेव च काकुत्स्थो विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत् || १-२८-१

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
गृहीतास्त्रोऽस्मि भगवन् दुराधर्षः सुरैरपि |

			अस्त्राणां त्वहमिच्छामि संहारं मुनिपुंगव || १-२८-२
translation:
"Oh, godly sage, I have taken the missiles and became unassailable even 
			for gods, but oh, eminent sage, I wish to know the annulment of missiles 
			too." So said Rama to the sage. [1-28-2]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः |

			संहारान् व्याजहाराथ धृतिमान् सुव्रतः शुचिः || १-२८-३

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
सत्यवन्तं सत्यकीर्तिं धृष्टं रभसमेव च |

			प्रतिहारतरं नाम पराङ्मुखमवाङ्मुखम् || १-२८-४

			लक्ष्यालक्ष्याविमौ चैव दृढनाभसुनाभकौ |

			दशाक्षशतवक्त्रौ च दशशीर्षशतोदरौ || १-२८-५

			पद्मनाभमहानाभौ दुन
translation:
"Oh, Raghava, take these radiant missile-children of Krishaasva from 
			me, namely Satyavanta, Satyakeerti, Dhristha, Rabhasa, Pratihaaratara, 
			Paraanmuka, Avaanmukha, Lakshya, Alakshya, Dhridhanaabha, Sunaabha, 
			Dashaaksha, Shatavaktra, Dashasheersha, Shatodara, Padmanaabha, Mahaanaabha,

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
बाढमित्येव काकुत्स्थ प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना |

			दिव्यभास्वरदेहाश्च मूर्तिमन्तः सुखप्रदाः || १-२८-११

			केचिदङ्गारसदृशाः केचिद् धूमोपमास्तथा |

			चन्द्रार्कसदृशाः केचित् प्रह्वांजलिपुटास्तथा || १-२८

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
गम्यतामिति तानाह यथेष्टं रघुनन्दनः |

			मानसाः कार्यकालेषु साहाय्यं मे करिष्यथ || १-२८-१४
translation:
"While remaining in my memory you assist me as and when needed, and 
			till then you may go away as you wish," thus that legatee of Raghu-s said 
			to those deities of annulment missiles. [1-28-14]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
अथ ते राममामन्त्र्य कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम् |

			एवमस्त्विति काकुत्स्थमुक्त्वा जग्मुर्यथागतम् || १-२८-१५

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
स च तान् राघवो ज्ञात्वा विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम् |

			गच्छन्नेवाथ मधुरं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रवीत् || १-२८-१६

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
किं न्वेतन्मेघसंकाशं पर्वतस्याविदूरतः |

			वृक्षखण्डमिवाभाति परं कौतूहलं हि मे || १-२८-१७

			दर्शनीयं मृगाकीर्णं मनोहरमतीव च |

			नानाप्रकारैः शकुनैर्वल्गुभाषैरलंकृतम् || १-२८-१८
translation:
"What is this cloudlike picturesque thicket shining forth not very far 
			away on this side of mountain, with animals spreading over it, and embellished 
			with numerous kinds of birds that have pleasant callings it is highly 
			soul-delighting, thus, my inquisitiveness is growing very much to kn

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
निःसृताः स्म मुनिश्रेष्ठ कान्ताराद्रोमहर्षणात् |

			अनया त्ववगच्छामि देशस्य सुखवत्तया || १-२८-१९

			सर्वं मे शंस भगवन् कस्याश्रमपदं त्विदम् |
translation:
"By the nature of happy environs at this place, oh, eminent sage, I 
			understand that we have come out of the extremely alarming forest of 
			Tataka, but oh, god, whose hermitage's threshold is this, kindly tell 
			me all. [1-28-19]

sargaTitle: vishvAmitra teaches rAma about annulment of missiles
sanskrit:
संप्राप्ता यत्र ते पापा ब्रह्मघ्ना दुष्टचारिणः | १-२८-२०

			तव यज्ञस्य विघ्नाय दुरात्मानो महामुनेः |

			भगवंस्तस्य को देशः सा यत्र तव याज्ञिकी || १-२८-२१

			रक्षितव्या क्रिया ब्रह्मन् मया वध्याश्च
translation:
"Oh, great saint, where are those murderers of Brahmans? Oh, venerable 
			one, at which place those evil minded sinners and evildoers will be 
			coming to hinder your ritual? And where, oh, Brahman, I have to safeguard 
			your ritual ceremonies, and demons too are to be eliminated? Oh, eminent

sanskrit:
अथ तस्याप्रमेयस्य वचनं परिपृच्छतः |

			विश्वामित्रो महातेजा व्याख्यातुमुपचक्रमे || १-२९-१

इह राम महाबाहो विष्णुर्देवनमस्कृतः |

			वर्षाणि सुबहूनीह तथा युगशतानि च || १-२९-२

			तपश्चरणयोगार्थमुवास सुमहातपाः |
translation:
"Here, oh, dextrous Rama, he who is worshipped by gods and who has got 
			outstanding ascesis that Vishnu resided here in the pursuit of practising 
			ascesis and yoga for good many years, likewise for a hundred eras. [1-29-2, 
			3a]

sanskrit:
एष पूर्वाश्रमो राम वामनस्य महात्मनः || १-२९-३

			सिद्धाश्रम इति ख्यातः सिद्धो ह्यत्र महातपाः |
translation:
"This is the erstwhile hermitage of great-souled Vaamana renowned as 
			Accomplished hermitage, why because the sage with supreme ascesis Kaashyapa 
			got accomplishment to such of his ascesis there only. [1-29-3b, 4a]

sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजा वैरोचनिर्बलिः || १-२९-४

			निर्जित्य दैवतगणान् सेन्द्रान् समरुद्गणान् |

			कारयामास तद्राज्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः || १-२९-५
translation:
"In the meantime, when Vishnu was in his asceticism in this hermitage, 
			the son of King Virochana, namely Bali, has completely conquered all 
			the assemblages of gods together with Indra and his coterie called Wind-gods, 
			and ruling that kingdom where that hermitage is there, he has become

sanskrit:
यज्ञं चकार सुमहानसुरेन्द्रो महाबलः |

			बलेस्तु यजमानस्य देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः |

			समागम्य स्वयं चैव विष्णुमूचुरिहाश्रमे || १-२९-६
translation:
"That great mighty chief of demons Bali then conducted a very grand 
			Vedic ritual. But when Bali is conducting that ritual remaining as its 
			officiator all the gods personally approached Vishnu, keeping Fire-god 
			ahead of them, just here in this hermitage and they spoke to him. [1-29-6]

sanskrit:
बलिर्वैरोचनिर्विष्णो यजते यज्ञमुत्तमम् |

			असमाप्तव्रते तस्मिन् स्वकार्यमभिपद्यताम् || १-२९-७
translation:
" 'Oh, all-pervading god Vishnu, Bali the son of Virochana is conducting 
			an unsurpassed Vedic ritual, before the completion of which our own 
			mission, say the task of gods, is to be achieved completely. [1-29-7]

sanskrit:
ये चैनमभिवर्तन्ते याचितार इतस्ततः |

			यच्च यत्र यथावच्च सर्वं तेभ्यः प्रयच्छति || १-२९-८
translation:
" 'Whoever the supplicant might be and from wherever he might be coming, 
			but if one approaches and supplicates to him he is donating that in 
			as is where is condition, whatever is supplicated and wherever it might 
			be. [1-29-8]

sanskrit:
स त्वं सुरहितार्थाय मायायोगमुपाश्रितः |

			वामनत्वं गतो विष्णो कुरु कल्याणमुत्तमम् || १-२९-९
translation:
" 'As such, oh, Vishnu, you may effectuate the most suitable merited 
			deed for the welfare of gods on resorting to your illusory power, Vishnu 
			Maya, and on assuming the form of a dwarf to deal with Emperor Bali.' 
			Thus gods appealed to Vishnu. [1-29-9]

sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम काश्यपोऽग्निसमप्रभः |

			अदित्या सहितो राम दीप्यमान इवौजसा || १-२९-१०

			देवीसहायो भगवान् दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् |

			व्रतं समाप्य वरदं तुष्टाव मधुसूदनम् || १-२९-११
translation:
"In the meanwhile, oh Rama, he whose brilliance is similar to ritual 
			fire, who will be with his wife Lady Aditi, who is resplendent with 
			his own vitality, that godly sage Kaashyapa on completing his asceticism 
			along with Lady Aditi started to eulogise the boon giver and the eliminator

sanskrit:
तपोमयं तपोराशिं तपोमूर्तिं तपात्मकम् |

			तपसा त्वां सुतप्तेन पश्यामि पुरोषोत्तमम् || १-२९-१२
translation:
" 'Oh, Supreme Person, you are abounding with asceticism, aggregate 
			of asceticism, the aspect of asceticism, and the very soul of asceticism, 
			such as you are, I am able to see you with the well practised asceticism 
			of mine. [1-29-12]

sanskrit:
शरीरे तव पश्यामि जगत्सर्वमिदं प्रभो |

			त्वमनादिरनिर्देश्यस्त्वामहं शरणं गतः || १-२९-१३
translation:
" 'In your physique I am seeing this entire universe, oh, god, and you 
			are without a beginning and indefinable, and in you I am taking shelter.' 
			Sage Kaashyapa praised Vishnu in this way. [1-29-13]

sanskrit:
तमुवाच हरिः प्रीतः कश्यपं धूतकल्मषम् |

			वरं वरय भद्रं ते वरार्होऽसि मतो मम || १-२९-१४

तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य मारीचः कश्यपोऽब्रवीत् |

			अदित्या देवतानां च मम चैवानुयाचितम् || १-२९-१५

			वरं वरद सुप्रीतो दातुमर्हसि सुव्रत |

पुत्रत्वं गच्छ भगवन्नदित्या मम चानघ || १-२९-१६

			भ्राता भव यवीयांस्त्वं शक्रस्यासुरसूदन |

			शोकार्तानां तु देवानां साहाय्यं कर्तुमर्हसि || १-२९-१७
translation:
" 'Oh, god, oh, sinless one, you may please attain the sonship of Lady 
			Aditi and myself, oh, dispenser of demons, it will be apt of you to 
			render help to gods who are agonised in the anguish owing to the predominance 
			of Emperor Bali, by becoming the younger brother of Indra. [1-29-16b,

sanskrit:
अयं सिद्धाश्रमो नाम प्रसादात्ते भविष्यति |

			सिद्धे कर्मणि देवेश उत्तिष्ठ भगवन्नितः || १-२९-१८
translation:
" 'Oh, god of gods, as the works of my austerities are accomplished 
            here, by your grace this hermitage will be renowned by the name Siddhaashram, 
            Hermitage of Accomplishment, hence oh god, arise from here to 
			become my son.' So said sage Kaashyapa to Vishnu. [1-29-18]

sanskrit:
अथ विष्णुर्महातेजा अदित्यां समजायत |

			वामनं रूपमास्थाय वैरोचनिमुपागमत् || १-२९-१९
translation:
"That great resplendent Vishnu then adopting a semblance of a dwarf 
			emerged from Aditi, and that dwarfish ascetic boy approached Emperor 
			Bali, the son of Virochana." Thus Vishvamitra continued narration. [1-29-19]

sanskrit:
त्रीन्पदानथ भिक्षित्वा प्रतिगृह्य च मेदिनीम् |

			आक्रम्य लोकान् लोकार्थो सर्वलोकहिते रतः || १-२९-२०

			महेन्द्राय पुनः प्रादात् नियम्य बलिमोजसा |

			त्रैलोक्यं स महातेजाश्चक्रे शक्रवशं पुनः || १-२
translation:
"That dwarf ascetic boy Vaamana begged and received a space that can 
			be covered in three strides, but strode all the three worlds in those 
			three steps for the purpose of saving worlds, as he is interested in 
			the welfare of all the worlds. Vishnu gave the earth back to Indra restraining

sanskrit:
तेनैष पूर्वमाक्रान्त आश्रमः श्रमनाशनः |

			मयापि भक्त्या तस्यैष वामनस्योपभुज्यते || १-२९-२२
translation:
"This hermitage which at one time is presided by Vishnu, is an eradicator 
			of stress, either the stress and strain caused by the evil on earth, 
			or the stress of going through the cycle of birth and death, thus this 
			hermitage is an accorded of salvation, and I am also beneficed with 
			th

sanskrit:
एनमाश्रममायान्ति राक्षसा विघ्नकारिणः |

			अत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्र हन्तव्या दुष्टचारिणः || १-२९-२३
translation:
"Demons causing obstacles, oh, tigerly man Rama, will be arriving at 
			that hermitage and there alone those demons with evil pursuit are to 
			be eliminated. [1-29-23]

sanskrit:
अद्य गच्छामहे राम सिद्धाश्रममनुत्तमम् |

			तदाश्रमपदं तात तवाप्येतद्यथा मम || १-२९-२४
translation:
"Rama, we now go to the unexcelled hermitage of Accomplishment, oh, 
			dear one, as to how this hermitage belongs to me, this also belongs 
			to you." Thus Vishvamitra said to Rama. [1-29-24]

sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा परमप्रीतो गृह्य रामं सलक्ष्मणम् |

			प्रविशन्नाश्रमपदं व्यरोचत महामुनिः |

			शशीव गतनीहारः पुनर्वसुसमन्वितः || १-२९-२५

तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे सिद्धाश्रमनिवासिनः |

			उत्पत्योत्पत्य सहसा विश्वामित्रमपूजयन् || १-२९-२६

यथार्हं चक्रिरे पूजां विश्वामित्राय धीमते |

			तथैव राजपुत्राभ्यामकुर्वन्नतिथिक्रियाम् || १-२९-२७

मुहूर्तमथ विश्रान्तौ राजपुत्रावरिन्दमौ |

			प्रांजली मुनिशार्दूलमूचतू रघुनंदनौ || १-२९-२८

अद्यैव दीक्षां प्रविश भद्रं ते मुनिपुंगव |

			सिद्धाश्रमोऽयं सिद्धः स्यात् सत्यमस्तु वचस्तव || १-२९-२९
translation:
"Oh, the eminent sage, today itself you may undertake the ritual of 
			solemnity that is undertaken prior to the main ritual, be safe, and 
			let this Hermitage of Accomplishment become an accomplished one in eradiating 
			vice true to its name, and let the word of yours given to my father 
			in

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महानृषिः |

			प्रविवेश तदा दीक्षां नियतो नियतेन्द्रियः || १-२९-३०

कुमारावेव तां रात्रिमुषित्वा सुसमाहितौ |

			प्रभातकाले चोत्थाय पूर्वां संध्यामुपास्य च || १-२९-३१

			प्रशुची परं जप्यं समाप्य नियमेन च |

			हुताग्निहोत्रमासीनं विश्वामित्रमवन्दताम् || १-२९-३२

अथ तौ देशकालज्ञौ राजपुत्रावरिंदमौ |

देशे काले च वाक्यज्ञावब्रूतां कौशिकं वचः || १-३०-१

भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छावो यस्मिन्काले निशाचरौ |

संरक्षणीयौ तौ ब्रूहि नातिवर्तेत तत्क्षणम् || १-३०-२
translation:
"Oh, god, we are interested to listen at which time those night-walkers come to 
disturb the ritual, and at which time we have to safeguard the ritual from them, 
that you tell us, let not that moment pass away." [1-30-2]

sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवाणौ काकुत्स्थौ त्वरमाणौ युयुत्सया |

सर्वे ते मुनयः प्रीताः प्रशशंसुर्नृपात्मजौ || १-३०-३

अद्य प्रभृति षड्रात्रं रक्षतं राघवौ युवाम् |

दीक्षां गतो ह्येष मुनिर्मौनित्वं च गमिष्यति || १-३०-४
translation:
"Oh, Raghava-s, you have to safeguard this ritual for six nights and days from today, 
and this Sage Vishvamitra who is under the vow of ritual goes into muteness as required 
by the vow." Thus said the other sages near at ritual place. [1-30-4]

sanskrit:
तौ तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रौ यशस्विनौ |

अनिद्रौ षडहोरात्रं तपोवनमरक्षताम् || १-३०-५

उपासांचक्रतुर्वीरौ यत्तौ परमधन्विनौ |

ररक्षतुर्मुनिवरं विश्वामित्रमरिंदमौ || १-३०-६

अथ काले गते तस्मिन् षष्ठेऽहनि तदागते |

सौमित्रमब्रवीद्रामो यत्तो भव समाहितः || १-३०-७

रामस्यैवं ब्रुवाणस्य त्वरितस्य युयुत्सया |

प्रजज्वाल ततो वेदिः सोपाध्यायपुरोहिता || १-३०-८

सदर्भचमसस्रुक्का ससमित्कुसुमोच्चया |

विश्वामित्रेण सहिता वेदिर्जज्वाल सर्त्विजा || १-३०-९

मंत्रवच्च यथान्यायं यज्ञोऽसौ संप्रवर्तते |

आकाशे च महान् शब्दः प्रादुरासीद्भयानकः || १-३०-१०

आवार्य गगनं मेघो यथा प्रावृषि दृश्यते |

तथा मायां विकुर्वाणौ राक्षसावभ्यधावताम् || १-३०-११

मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च तयोरनुचरास्तथा |
