the goddess of wealth, you bear the earth with all its created beings along with its
mountains."

sanskrit:
अन्ते पृथिव्याः सलिले दृश्यसे त्वं महोरगः || ६-११७-२३

त्रीन् लोकान् धारयन् राम देवगन्धर्वदानवान् |
translation:
"O Rama! You appear as Sesha, a large serpent in water, at the earth's bottom,
bearing the three worlds, gods, Gandharvas, the celestial musicians and the demons."

sanskrit:
अहं ते हृदयं राम जिह्वा देवी सरस्वती || ६-११७-२४

देवा रोमाणि गात्रेषु ब्रह्मणा निर्मिताः प्रभो |
translation:
"O Rama! I (brahma) am your heart. Saraswathi, the goddess (of learning) is your
tongue. O lord! The gods created by Brahma are the hair on all your limbs."

sanskrit:
निमेषस्ते स्मृता रात्रिरुन्मेषो दिवसस्तथा || ६-११७-२५

संस्कारास्त्वभवन्वेदा नैतदस्ति त्वया विना |
translation:
"Night has been recognized as the closing of your eye-lids and the day, as the
opening of eye-lids. The correct usages of your words are the Vedas. Bereft of you, this visible
universe does not exist."

sanskrit:
जगत्सर्वं शरीरं ते स्थैर्यं ते वसुधातलम् || ६-११७-२६

अग्निः कोपः प्रसादस्ते सोमः श्रीवत्सलक्षणः |
translation:
"The entire cosmos is your body. The earth constitutes your firmness. Fire is your
anger. The moon constitutes your placidity. You are Lord Vishnu (who bears the mark Srivatsa - a
curl of white hair on his breast)."

sanskrit:
त्वया लोकास्त्रयः क्रान्ताः पुरा स्वैर्विक्रमैस्त्रिभिः || ६-११७-२७

महेन्द्रश्च कृतो राजा बलिं बद्ध्वा सुदारुणम् |
translation:
"In the past, the three worlds were occupied by you in your three strides, after
binding the exceptionally formidable Bali (the ruler of the three worlds) and Indra was made the
king (by you)."

sanskrit:
सीता लक्ष्मीर्भवान् विष्णुर्देवः कृष्णः प्रजापतिः || ६-११७-२८

वधार्थं रावणस्येह प्रविष्टो मानुषीं तनुम् |
translation:
"Seetha is no other than Goddess Lakshmi (the divine consort of Lord Vishnu), while
you are Lord Vishnu. You are having a shining dark-blue hue. You are the Lord of created beings.
For the destruction of Ravana, you entered a human body here, on this earth."

sanskrit:
तदिदं नस्त्वया कार्यं कृतं धर्मभृतां वर || ६-११७-२९

निहतो रावणो राम प्रहृष्टो दिवमाक्रम |
translation:
"O Rama, the foremost among the supporters of righteousness! The aforesaid purpose
of ours has been fulfilled. Ravana has been killed. Return to your divine abode, with a
rejoice."

sanskrit:
अमोघं देव वीर्यं ते न ते मोघाः पराक्रमाः || ६-११७-३०

अमोघं दर्शनं राम अमोघस्तव संस्तवः |
translation:
"O Lord! Unerring is your valour. Your exploits are never in vain. O Rama! Your
blessed sight is powerful. The songs in praise of you never go in vain."

sanskrit:
अमोघास्ते भविष्यन्ति भक्तिमन्तो नरा भुवि || ६-११७-३१

ये त्वां देवम् ध्रुवं भक्ताः पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम् |

प्राप्नुवन्ति सदा कामानिह लोके पात्र च || ६-११७-३२
translation:
"Those humans who are full of devotion to you will never be unsuccessful on this
earth. Those who are devoted to you, the primeval and the eternal lord, belonging to ancient times
and the Supreme Person, will forever attain their desired objects here as well as hereafter."

sanskrit:
इममार्षम् स्तवं दिव्यमितिहासं पुरातनम् || ६-११७-३३

ये नराः कीर्तयिष्यन्ति नास्ति तेषां पराभवः |
translation:
"Humiliation will never be the plight of those humans who will recite this hymn in a
divine ancient history, sung by Brahma, the foremost seer."

sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं पितामहसमीरितम् |

अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीमुत्पपात विभावसुः || ६-११८-१

विधूयाथ चितां तां तु विअदेहीं हव्यवाहनः |

उत्तस्थौ मूर्तिमानाशु गृहीत्वा जनकात्मजाम् || ६-११८-२

तरुणादित्यसंकाशां तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाम् |

रक्ताम्बरधरां बालां नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजाम् || ६-११८-३

अक्लिष्टमाल्याभरणां तथारूपामनिन्दिताम् |

ददौ रामाय वैदेहीमङ्के कृत्वा विभावसुः || ६-११८-४

अब्रवीत्तु तदा रामं साक्षी लोकस्य पावकः |

एषा ते राम वैदेही पापमस्यां न विद्यते || ६-११८-५

नैव वाचा न मनसा नैव बुद्ध्या न चक्षुषा |

सुवृत्ता वृत्तशौण्डीर्यं न त्वामत्यचरच्छुभा || ६-११८-६
translation:
"This auspicious lady, whose character has been good, has never been unfaithful to
you who are endowed with strength of character either by word or by mind or even by intellect or by
her glances."

sanskrit:
रावणेनापनीतैषा वीर्योत्सिक्तेन रक्षसा |

त्वया विरहिता दीना विवशा निर्जनाद्वनात् || ६-११८-७
translation:
"Separated from you, this miserable and helpless lady, was taken away by Ravana the
demon, who was arrogant of his valour, from a lonely hermitage."

sanskrit:
रुद्ध चान्तःपुरे गुप्ता त्वच्चित्ता त्वत्परायणा |

रक्षिता राक्षसीभिश्च घोराभिर्घोरबुद्धिभिः || ६-११८-८
translation:
"This Seetha, who was fixing her mind upon you ad looking on you as her final
attainment, was detained in the gynaecium and hidden there. She was guarded by rightful
female-demons with horrible intellect."

sanskrit:
प्रलोभ्यमाना विविधं तर्ज्यमाना च मैथिली |

नाचिन्तयत तद्रक्षस्त्वद्गतेनान्तरात्मना || ६-११८-९
translation:
"Seetha, whose mind was directed towards you, ignored that demon even though allured
and frightened through various means."

sanskrit:
विशुद्धभावां निष्पापां प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मैथिलीम् |

न किंचिरभिधातव्या अहमाज्ञापयामि ते || ६-११८-१०
translation:
"Take back Seetha, who is sinless, with a pure character. She should not be told
anything harsh. I hereby command you."

sanskrit:
ततः प्रीतमना रामः श्रुत्वैवं वदतां वरः |

दध्यौ मुहूर्तं धर्मात्मा बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः || ६-११८-११

एवमुक्तो महातेजा धृमानुरुविक्रमः |

उवाच त्रिदशश्रेष्ठं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः || ६-११८-१२

अवश्यं चापि लोकेषु सीता पावनमर्हति |

दीर्घकालोषिता हीयं रावणान्तःपुरे शुभा || ६-११८-१३
translation:
"Seetha certainly deserves this pure factory ordeal in the eyes of the people in as
much as this blessed woman had resided for a long time indeed in the gynaecium of Ravana.

sanskrit:
बालिशो बत कामात्म रामो दशरथात्मजः |

इति वक्ष्यति मां लोको जानकीमविशोध्य हि || ६-११८-१४
translation:
"The world would chatter against me, saying that Rama, the son of Dasaratha, was
really foolish and that his mind was dominated by lust, if I accept Seetha without examining her
with regard to her chastity."

sanskrit:
अनन्यहृदयां भक्तां मचत्तपरिवर्तिनीम् |

अहमप्यवगच्छामि मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम् || ६-११८-१५
translation:
"I also know that Seetha, the daughter of Janaka, who ever revolves in my mind, is
undivided in her affection to me."

sanskrit:
इमामपि विशालाक्षीं रक्षितां स्वेन तेजसा |

रावणो नातिवर्तेत वेल मिव महोदधिः || ६-११८-१६
translation:
"Ravana could not violate this wide-eyed woman, protected as she was by her own
splendour, any more than an ocean would transgress its bounds."

sanskrit:
प्रत्ययार्थं तु लोकानां त्रयाणाम् सत्यसंश्रयः |

उपेक्षे चापि वैदेहीं प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम् || ६-११८-१७
translation:
"In order to convince the three worlds, I, whose refugee is truth, ignored Seetha
while she was entering the fire."

sanskrit:
न च शक्तः सुदुष्टत्मा मनसापि हि मैथिलीम् |

प्रधर्षयितुमप्राप्यां दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव || ६-११८-१८
translation:
"The evil-minded Ravana was not able to lay his violent hands, even in thought, o
the unobtainable Seetha, who was blazing like a flaming tongue of fire."

sanskrit:
नेय मर्हति चैश्वर्यं रावणान्तःपुरे शुभा |

अनन्या हि मया सीता भास्करेण प्रभा यथा || ६-११८-१९
translation:
"This auspicious woman could not give way to the sovereignty, existing in the
gynaecium of Ravana, in as much as Seetha is not different from me, even as sunlight is not
different from the sun."

sanskrit:
विशुद्धा त्रिषु लोकेषु मैथिली जनकात्मजा |

न विहातुं मया शक्या कीर्तिरात्मवता यथा || ६-११८-२०
translation:
"Seetha, the daughter of Janaka, is completely pure in her character, in all the
three worlds and can no longer be renounced by me, as a good name cannot be cast aside by a prudent
man."

sanskrit:
अवश्यं च मया कार्यं सर्वेषां वो वचो हितम् |

स्निग्धानां लोकनाथानामेवं च वदतां हितम् || ६-११८-२१

इत्येवमुक्त्वा विजयी महाबलः |

प्रशस्यमानह् स्वकृतेन कर्मणा |

समेत्य रामः प्रियया महायशाः |

सुखं सुखार्होऽनुबभूव राघवः || ६-११८-२२

एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं राघवेण सुभाषितम् |

इदं शुभतरं वाक्यं व्याजहार महेश्वरः || ६-११९-१

पुष्कराक्ष महाबाहो महावक्षः परन्तप |

दिष्ट्या कृतमिदं कर्म त्वया शस्त्रभृतां वर || ६-११९-२
translation:
"O lotus-eyed, long-armed, broad-chested, annihilator of enemies and excellent among
those upholding the cause of virtue! Thank heaven! You accomplished this task."

sanskrit:
दिष्ट्या सर्वस्य लोकस्य प्रवृद्धं दारुणं तमः |

अपावृत्तं त्वया सङ्ख्ये राम रावणजं भयम् || ६-११९-३
translation:
"Fortunately has the fear born of Ravana - which increased the severe darkness on
the entire world has been removed by you, on the battle-field, O Rama!"

sanskrit:
आश्वास्य भरतं दीनं कौसल्यां च यशस्विनीम् |

कैकेयीं च सुमित्रां च दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमातरम् || ६-११९-४

प्राप्य राज्यमयोध्यायां नन्दयित्वा सुहृज्जनम् |

इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले वंशं स्थापयित्वा महाबल || ६-११९-
translation:
"You are fit to go to the heaven, by comforting the depressed Bharata and the
illustrious Kausalya as well as seeing Kaikeyi and Sumitra, the mother of Lakshmana having got the
sovereignty of Ayodhya, bringing delight to your friends, stabilizing the back-bone in the race of
Ikshvaku, getting excell

sanskrit:
एष राजा विमानस्थः पिता दशरथस्तव |

काकुत्स्थ मानुषे लोके गुरुस्तव महायशाः || ६-११९-७
translation:
"This king Dasaratha, your father in this mortal world and the highly glorious as
well as the venerable person, is seated in an aerial car, O Rama!"

sanskrit:
इन्द्रलोकं गतः श्रीमांस्त्वया पुत्रेण तारितः |

लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा त्वमेनमभिवादय || ६-११९-८
translation:
"Having been delivered by you, his (godly) son, the glorious king obtained the abode
of Indra the lord of celestials. you offer your respectful salutation to him, along with Lakshmana,
your brother."

sanskrit:
महादेववचः श्रुत्वा काकुत्स्थः सहलक्ष्मणः |

विमानशिखरस्थस्य प्रणाममकरोत्पितुः || ६-११९-९

दीप्यमानं स्वयां लक्ष्म्या विरजोअम्बरधारिणम् |

लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श पितरं प्रभुः || ६-११९-१०

हर्षेण महताविष्टो विमानस्थो महीपतिः |

प्राणैः प्रियतरं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं दशरथस्तदा || ६-११९-११

आरोप्याङ्कं महाबाहुर्वरासनगतः प्रभुः |

बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य ततो वाक्यं समाददे || ६-११९-१२

न मे स्वर्गो बहुमतः संमानश्च सुरर्षिभिः |

त्वया राम विहीनस्य सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते || ६-११९-१३
translation:
"O Rama! Separated from you, the heaven is not a liking to me, nor the respect given
to me by the foremost of celestials. I am telling you the truth."

sanskrit:
अद्य त्वां निहतामित्रं दृष्ट्वा संपूर्णमानसम् |

निस्तीर्णवनवासं च प्रीतिरासीत्परा मम| ६-११९-१४
translation:
"Today, there is a great joy for me, for having seen you, fully satisfied in your
mind, now that your enemies have been destroyed and you have fully gone through the period of
exile."

sanskrit:
कैकेय्या यानि चोक्तानि वाक्यानि वदतां वर |

तव प्रव्राजनार्थानि स्थितानि हृदये मम || ६-११९-१५
translation:
"O excellent among the eloquent! The words, which were uttered by Kaikeyi, with an
aim to send you into exile, are still imprinted in my heart."

sanskrit:
त्वां तु दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनं परिष्वज्य सलक्ष्मणम् |

अद्य दुःखाद्विमुक्तोअस्मि नीहारादिव भास्करः || ६-११९-१६
translation:
"Seeing you in a fine fettle with Lakshmana and hugging you today, I stand
completely rid of sorrow - even as the sun is freed from mist."

sanskrit:
तारितोअहं त्वया पुत्र सुपुत्रेण महात्मना |

अष्टावक्रेण धर्मात्मा तारितो ब्राह्मणो यथा || ६-११९-१७
translation:
"O great-souled son! I have been redeemed by you, my worthy son, even as Kahola a
brahmana was redeemed by Ashtavakra."

sanskrit:
इदानीं च विजानामि यथा सौम्य सुरेश्वरैः |

वधार्थं रावणस्येह विहितं पुरुषोत्तमम् || ६-११९-१८
translation:
"O gently one! I recognize you now to be the Supreme person, duly enjoined here by
the rulers of gods, for the destruction of Ravana."

sanskrit:
सिद्धार्था खलु कौसल्या या त्वां राम गृहं गतम् |

वनान्निवृत्तं संहृष्टा द्रक्ष्यते शत्रुसूदन || ६-११९-१९
translation:
"Blessed indeed is Kausalya, who will see you, the destroyer of your enemies,
returned home from the forest."

sanskrit:
सिद्धार्थाः खलु ते राम नरा ये त्वां पुरीं गतम् |

राज्ये चैवाभिषिक्तं च द्रक्ष्यन्ति वसुधाधिपम् || ६-११९-२०
translation:
"Blessed indeed are those men, who will see you returned to the City of Ayodhya and
consecrated on the throne as a lord of the earth."

sanskrit:
अनुरक्तेन बलिना शुचिना धर्मचारिणा |

इच्छेयं त्वामहं द्रष्टुं भरतेन समागतम् || ६-११९-२१
translation:
"I desire to see you, re-united with the mighty Bharata, who is affectionate towards
you, honest and virtuous."

sanskrit:
चतुर्दशसमाः सौम्य वने निर्यापितास्त्वया |

वसता सीतया सार्धं लक्ष्मणेन च धीमता || ६-११९-२२
translation:
"O gentle one! You spent fourteen years, residing in the forest with Lakshmana and
Seetha."

sanskrit:
निवृत्तवनवासोअसि प्रतिज्ञा सफला कृता |

रावणं च रणे हत्वा देवास्ते परितोषिताः || ६-११९-२३
translation:
"You completed the term of your exile. My pledge was implemented by you. The
celestials too have been fully gratified, by your killing of Ravana in battle."

sanskrit:
कृतं कर्म यशः श्लाघ्यं प्राप्तं ते शत्रुसूदन |

भ्रातृभिः सह राज्यस्थो दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुहि || ६-११९-२४
translation:
"O the destroyer of enemies! A laudable act has been done and glory has been earned
by you. Getting consecrated on the throne, may you attain a long life, along with your
brothers."

sanskrit:
इति ब्रुवाणं राजानं रामः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत् |

कुरु प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कैकेय्या भरतस्य च || ६-११९-२५

सपुत्रां त्वां त्यजामीति यदुक्ता कैकयी त्वया |

स शापः कैकयीं घोरः सपुत्रां न स्पृशेत्प्रभो || ६-११९-२६

तथेति महाराजो राममुक्त्वा कृताञ्जलिम् |

लक्ष्मणं च परिष्वज्य पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच ह || ६-११९-२७

रामं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया |

कृता मम महाप्रीतिः प्राप्तं धर्मफलं च ते || ६-११९-२८
translation:
"A great gratification has been rendered to me and reward in the form of religious
merit earned by you in that you served Rama and Seetha, the princess of Videha kingdom, with
devotion."

sanskrit:
धर्मं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ यशश्च विपुलं भुवि |

रामे प्रसन्ने स्वर्गं च महिमानं तथैव च || ६-११९-२९
translation:
"Rama, being pleased with you, you will attain religious merit and extensive glory
on earth, as also heaven and excellent power O knower of righteousness!"

sanskrit:
रामं शुश्रूष भद्रं ते सुमित्रानन्दवर्धन |

रामः सर्वस्य लोकस्य शुभेष्वभिरतः सदा || ६-११९-३०
translation:
"Happiness to you, O the augmentor of the joy of Sumitra, your mother! Serve Rama
well. Rama forever is intent on advancing the interests of the entire world."

sanskrit:
एते सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः |

अभिगम्य महात्मानमर्चन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम् || ६-११९-३१
translation:
"These three worlds, including Indra Siddhas (a class of demi-gods) and great sages
pay homage to the great-souled Rama as a Supreme person, on approaching him."

sanskrit:
एतत्तदुक्तमव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् |

देवानां हृदयं सौम्य गुह्यं रामः परन्तपः || ६-११९-३२
translation:
"O great one! O the destroyer of adversaries! Rama has been spoken of as the
unmanifest and the imperishable Brahama (the absolute), established by the Vedas, the heart of gods
and the secret of all gods."

sanskrit:
अवाप्तं धर्मचरणं यशश्च विपुलं त्वया |

एनं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया || ६-११९-३३
translation:
"Having served him, along with Seetha with devotion, you obtained the reward of the
practice of all virtues as also celebrity, abundantly."

sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं राजा स्नुषां बद्धाञ्जलिं स्थिताम् |

पुत्रीत्याभाष्य मधुरं शनैरेनामुवाच ह || ६-११९-३४

कर्तव्यो न तु वैदेहि मन्युस्त्यागमिमं प्रति |

रामेण त्वद्विशुद्ध्यर्थं कृतमेतद्धितैषिणा || ६-११९-३५
translation:
"No wrath indeed should be rendered by you towards Rama, for having repudiated you.
This has been done by him, wishing for your welfare and in order to demostrate your purity."

sanskrit:
सुदुष्करमिदं पुत्रि तव चारित्रलक्षणम् |

कृतं यत्तेऽन्यनारीणां यशो ह्यभिभविष्यति| ६-११९-३६
translation:
"This act (of entering into fire) which has been done by you and which reveals your
true character, my daughter, is the most difficult task to perform for other ladies and will
overshadow their illustriousness."

sanskrit:
न त्वं सुभ्रु समाधेया पतिशुश्रूवणं प्रति |

अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यमेष ते दैवतं परम् || ६-११९-३७
translation:
"You need not be instructed about the matter of rendering service to your husband.
But, it is to be told certainly by me. He is your supreme deity."

sanskrit:
इति प्रतिसमादिश्य पुत्रौ सीतां तथा स्नुषाम् |

इन्द्रलोकं विमानेन ययौ दशरथो ज्वलन् || ६-११९-३८

विमानमास्थाय महानुभावः |

श्रिया च संहृष्टतनुर्नृपोत्तमः |

आमन्त्य्र पुत्रौ सह सीतया च |

जगाम देवप्रवरस्य लोकम्| ६-११९-३९

प्रतिप्रयाते काकुत्थ्से महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः |

अब्रवीत् परमप्रीतो राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम् || ६-१२०-१

अमोघं दर्शनं राम तवास्माकं नरर्षभ |

प्रीतियुक्ताः स्म तेन त्वं ब्रूहि यन्मनसेप्सितम् || ६-१२०-२
translation:
"O Rama, the foremost among men! Your sight of us, should not go in vain. Therefore,
tell us whatever is desired by you."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो महेन्द्रेण प्रसन्नेन महात्मना |

सुप्रसन्नमना हृष्टो वचनम् प्राह राघवः || ६-१२०-३

यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना मयि ते विबुधेश्वर |

वक्ष्यामि कुरु मे सत्यम् वचनं वदतां वर || ६-१२०-४
translation:
"O the foremst among the eloquent! O Indra! If you have affection in me, I shall
speak out my words. Make my words real."

sanskrit:
मम हेतोः पराक्रान्ता ये गता यमसादनम् |

ते सर्वे जीवितं प्राप्य समुत्तिष्ठन्तु वानराः || ६-१२०-५
translation:
"Let all the monkeys, who reached the abode of death, after displaying their
energyfor

sanskrit:
मत्कृते विप्रयुक्ता ये पुत्रैर्दारैश्च वानराः |

तान् प्रीतमनसः सर्वान् द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद || ६-१२०-६
translation:
"O the bestower of honour! I wish to see all those monkeys, who for my sake, were
removed from their sons and wives, be delighted at heart."

sanskrit:
विक्रान्ताश्चापि शूराश्च न मृत्युं गणयन्ति च |

कृतयत्ना विपन्नाश्च जीवयैनान् पुरंदर || ६-१२०-७
translation:
"They were all valiant, proving their energies and did not take their death into
account. They made their strenuous efforts and died. O Indra! Restore their lives to them."

sanskrit:
मत्प्रियेष्वभिरक्ताश्च न मृत्युं गणयन्ति ये |

त्वत्प्रसादात्समेयुस्ते वरमेतमहं वृणे || ६-१२०-८
translation:
"Those mokeys - who coutned death as nothing and who were fond of doing favour to me
- let them get re-united with their near and dear ones by your grace. I seek this boon of you."

sanskrit:
नीरुजो निर्व्रणांश्चैव संपन्नबलपौरुषान् |

गोलाङ्गूलांस्तथर्क्षांश्च द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद || ६-१२०-९
translation:
"O bestower of honour! I wish to see the monkeys and bears, free from wounds and
pains, with augmented strength and valour."

sanskrit:
अकाले चापि पुष्पाणि मूलानि च फलानि च |

नद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र तिष्ठेयुर्यत्र वानराः || ६-१२०-१०
translation:
"Wherever the aforesaid monkeys live, let there be rivers with crystal-clear water,
flowers, roots and fruits even in an off-season."

sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः |

महेन्द्रह् प्रत्युवाचेदं वचनं प्रीतिसंयुतम् || ६-१२०-११

महानयं वरस्तात यस्त्वयोक्तो रघुत्तम |

द्विर्मया नोक्तपुर्वं च तस्मादेवद्भविष्यति || ६-१२०-१२
translation:
"O beloved Rama! This boon, which has been sought by you is hard to grant. No offer
has, however, been revised by me in the past. Therefore this will come to be."

sanskrit:
समुत्तिष्ठन्तु ते सर्वे हता ये युधि राक्षसैः |

ऋक्षाश्च सह गोपुच्छैर्निकृत्ताननबाहवः || ६-१२०-१३
translation:
"Let all those monkeys and bears along with long-tailed monkeys, who have been
killed in battle, by the demons and whose heads and arms have been severed, be alive and active
again."

sanskrit:
नीरुजो निर्व्रिणाश्चव संपन्नबलपौरुषाः |

समुत्थास्यन्ति हरयः सुप्ता निद्राक्षये यथा || ६-१२०-१४
translation:
"Without any ill-health andwounds and with boosted strength and valour, the monkeys
will srise again, as those fallen asleep would do at the end of their sleep."

sanskrit:
सुहृद्भिर्बान्धवैश्चव ज्ञातिभिः स्वजनेन च |

सर्व एव समेष्यन्ति संयुक्ताः परया मुदा || ६-१२०-१५
translation:
"All of them, full of delight, will get re-united with their friends, relatives,
kinsmen and family members."

sanskrit:
अकाले पुष्पशबलाः फलवन्तश्च पादपाः |

भविष्यन्ति महेष्वास नद्यश्च नलिलायुताः || ६-१२०-१६
translation:
"O the wielder of a great bow! The trees will look colourful with flowers and fruits
even in the off-season. Rivers too will remain constantly with water."

sanskrit:
सव्रणैः प्रथमं गात्रैरिदानीं निर्व्रणैः समैः |

ततः समुत्थिताः सर्वे सुप्त्वेव हरियूथपाः || ६-१२०-१७

बभूवुर्वानराः सर्वे किं न्वेतदिति विस्मिताः |

काकुत्थ्सं परिपूर्णार्थं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे सुरोत्तमाः || ६-१२०-१८

अब्रुवन् परमप्रीताः स्तुत्वा रामं सलक्ष्मणम् |

गच्छायोध्यामितो राजन् विसर्जय च वानरान् || ६-१२०-१९

मैथिलीं सान्त्वयस्वैनामनुरक्तां यशस्विनीम् |
translation:
"O monarch! Proceed to Ayodhya from here and disband the monkeys. Reassure this
illustrious and devoted Seetha."

sanskrit:
भ्रातरं भरतं पश्य त्वच्छोकाद्व्रतचारिणम् || ६-१२०-२०

शत्रुघ्नं च महात्मानं मातृइः सर्वाः परंतप |

अभिषेचय चात्मानम् पौरान्गत्वा प्रहर्षय || ६-१२०-२१
translation:
"O destroyer of adversaries! See Bharata, your brother, who is practising
austerities through grief caused by separation from you, the great-souled Shatrughna and all your
mohters. Get yourself consecrated on the throne. Bring rejoice to the citizens, by going
there."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षो रामं सौमित्रिणा सह |

विमानैः सूर्यसंकाशैर्ययौ हृष्टः सुरैह् सह || ६-१२०-२२

अभिवाद्य च काकुत्थ्सः सर्वांस्तांस्त्रिदशोत्तमान् |

लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वासमाज्ञापयत्तदा || ६-१२०-२३

ततस्तु सा लक्ष्मणरानुपालिता |

महाचमूर्हृष्टजना यशस्विनी |

श्रिया ज्वलन्तीविरराज सर्वतो |

निशा प्रणीतेव हि शीतरश्मिना || ६-१२०-२४

तां रात्रिमुषितं रामं सुखोदितमरिंदमम् |

अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं जयम् पृष्ट्वा विभीषणः || ६-१२१-१

स्नानानि चाङ्गारागाणि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च |

चन्दनानि च माल्यानि दिव्यानि विविधानि च || ६-१२१-२

अलंकारविदश्चैता नार्यः पद्मनिभेक्षणाः |

उपस्थितास्त्वां विधिवत् स्नापयिष्यन्ति राघव || ६-१२१-३
translation:
"These women with lotus-like eyes, who are skilled in the art of decoration, came
with bathing accessories like garments, ornaments, sandal-pastes and beautiful garlands of various
kinds. They will assist you in bathing O Rama!"

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम् |

हरीन् सुग्रीवमुख्यांस्त्वं स्नानेनोपनिमन्त्रय || ६-१२१-४

सत् उ ताम्यति धर्मात्मा मम हेतोः सुखोचितः |

सुकुमारो महाबाहुर्भरतः सत्यसंस्रयः || ६-१२१-५
translation:
"That Bharata, the virtuous man, who was accustomed to comfort, a delicate youth,
the great-armed and the one consistent with the truth is suffering on my account."

sanskrit:
तं विना कैकयीपुत्रम् भरतं धर्मचारिणम् |

न मे स्नानं बहुमतं वस्त्राण्यानि च || ६-१२१-६

एतत् पश्य यथा क्षिप्रं प्रतिगच्छाम ताम् पुरीम् |

अयोध्याम् गच्छतो ह्येष पन्थाह् परमदुर्गमः || ६-१२१-७
translation:
"See how we may return to that City of Ayodhya soon. It is indeed very difficult to
travel over this path to reach Ayodhya City, so soon."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थं प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः |

अह्ना त्वां प्रापयिष्यामि ताम् पुरीं पार्थिवात्मज || ६-१२१-८

पुष्पकं नाम भद्रं ते विमानं सूर्यसम्निभम् |

मम भ्रातुः कुबेरस्य रावणेन बलीयसा || ६-१२१-९

हृतं निर्जित्य सम्ग्रामे कामगं दिव्यमुत्तमम् |

त्वदर्थं पालितं चेदं तिष्ठत्यतुलविक्रम || ६-१२१-१०
translation:
"O Rama of unequalled prowess! The aerial car shining like the sun, which moves as
one pleases, wonderful and excellent, named Pushpaka of Kubera my brother was robbed by the mighty
Ravana after conquering Kubera in battle. May prosperity attend you! It is retained there for your
sake."

sanskrit:
तदिदं मेघसंकाशं विमानमिह तिष्ठति |

येन यास्यसि यानेन त्वमयोध्यां गतज्वरः || ६-१२१-११
translation:
"The yonder aerial car, looking like a cloud, stands here and by which transport,
you can reach Ayodhya without any trouble."

sanskrit:
अहम् ते यद्यनुग्राह्यो यदि स्मरसि मे गुणान् |

वस तावदिह प्राज्ञ यद्यस्ति मयि सौहृदम् || ६-१२१-१२
translation:
"O sagacious prince! If I deserve to be treated with kindness by you, if you think
of any virtue in me and if you think of any virtue in me and if you have any affection in me, stay
here for some more time."

sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या भार्यया सह |

अर्चितह् सर्वकामैस्त्वं ततो राम गमिष्यसि || ६-१२१-१३
translation:
"O Rama! When you have been offered with reference all the entertainments, you along
with Lakshmana, your brother and Seetha your consort, shall then depart."

sanskrit:
प्रीतियुक्तस्य विहितां ससैन्यः ससुहृद्गणः |

सत्क्रियां राम मे तावद्गृहाण त्वं मयोद्यताम् || ६-१२१-१४
translation:
"O Rama! In the meantime, accept you, with your entire army and assemblage of
friends, my hospitality which has been fixed and arranged by me, full of affection as I am."

sanskrit:
प्रणयाद्बहुमानाच्च सौहार्देन च राघव |

प्रसादयामि प्रेष्योऽहं न खल्वाज्ञापयामि ते || ६-१२१-१५
translation:
"O Rama! I entreat you with affection, respect and friendship I am your servant. I
am not in any way commanding you to do so."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्ततो रामह् प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम् |

रक्षसां वानराणां च सर्वेषमेव शृण्वताम् || ६-१२१-१६

पूजितोऽस्मि त्वया वीर साचिव्येन परंतप |

सर्वत्मना च चेष्टाभिः सौहार्देन परेण च || ६-१२१-१७
translation:
"O destroyer of enemies! O hero! I stand honoured by you by your valued counsel,
your efforts put forth with your whole soul and more so by your friendship.

sanskrit:
न खल्वेतन्न कुर्याम् ते वचनं राक्षसेश्वर |

तं तु मे भ्रातरं द्रष्टुम् भरतं त्वरते मनः || ६-१२१-१८
translation:
"O king of demons! It is not that I am not carrying out your words. But, my heart is
hastening to see that Bharata, my brother."

sanskrit:
मां निवर्तयितुं योऽसौ चित्रकूटमुपागतः |

शिरसा याचतो यस्य वचनम् न कृतं मया || ६-१२१-१९

कौसल्यां च सुमित्राम् च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम् |

गुहम् च सुहृदं चैव पौरान् जनपदैः सह || ६-१२१-२०
translation:
"My heart is hastening to see that Bharata, who came all the way to Mount Chitrakuta
to take me back to Ayodhya, yet whose appeal was not executed by me, even though he requested me
with his head bent low and Kausalya my mother as also Sumitra and the illustrious Kaikeyi (my
step-mothers) as also Gu

sanskrit:
अनुजानीहि मां सौम्य पूजितोऽस्मि विभीषण |

मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यः सखे त्वां चानुमानये || ६-१२१-२१
translation:
"O gentle Vibhishana! Allow me to go. I am honoured. O friend! You need not be
disappointed, I entreat you."

sanskrit:
उपस्थापय मे शीघ्रं विमानं राक्षसेश्वर |

कृतकार्यस्य मे वासह् कथम् स्यादिह संमतः || ६-१२१-२२
translation:
"O the king of demons! Fetch the aerial car immediately. How is it advisable for my
continued stay here, now that my task has been accomplished?"

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषनः |

विमानं सूर्यसम्काशमाजुहाव त्वरान्वितः || ६-१२१-२३

ततः काञ्चत्राङ्गं वैदूर्यमणिवेदिकम् |

काञ्चनं काञ्चनैर्हर्म्यैर्हेमपद्मविभूषितैः || ६-१२१-२४

पाण्डुराभिह

उपस्थितमनाधृष्यं तद्विमानं मनोजवम् |

निवेदयित्वा रामायतस्थौ तत्र विभीषणः || ६-१२१-२९

तत्पुष्पकम् कामगमं विमान |

मुपस्थितम् भूधरसंनिकाशम् |

दृष्ट्वा तदा विस्मयमाजगाम |

रामः ससौमित्रिरुदारस्त्त्वः || ६-१२१-३०

उपस्थितम् तु तं कृत्वा पुष्पकं पुष्पभूषितम् |

अविदूरे स्थितो राममित्युवाच विभीषणः || ६-१२२-१

स तु बद्धाञ्जलिपुटो विनीतो राक्षसेश्वरः |

अब्रवीत्त्वरयोपेतः किं करोमीति राघवम् || ६-१२२-२
translation:
"What more can I do?" thus spoke with haste, Vibhishana endowed as he was with
modesty and with joined palms, to Rama.

sanskrit:
तमब्रवीन्महातेजा लक्ष्मणस्योपशृण्वतः |

विमृश्य राघवो वाचमिदं स्नेहपुरस्कृतम् || ६-१२२-३

कृतप्रयत्नकर्माणः सर्व एव वनेचराः |

रत्नैरर्थैश्च विविधैः संपूज्यन्तां विभीषण || ६-१२२-४
translation:
"Let all these monkeys and bears (ie. Denizens of forests), who performed tasks of
exertion, be honoured with tasks of exertion, be honoured with precious stones and riches of
various kinds, O Vibhishana!"

sanskrit:
सहामीभिस्त्वया लङ्का निर्जिता राक्षसेश्वर |

हृष्टैः प्राणभयं त्यक्त्वा संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिभिः || ६-१२२-५
translation:
"O Vibhishana the king of demons! Lanka has conquered by you, in collaboration with
these monkeys, who never turned their backs in battles and fought joyfully, ignoring all risk to
their lives."

sanskrit:
त इमे कृतकर्माणः सर्व एव वनौकसः |

धनरत्नप्रदानेन कर्मैषां सफलं कुरु || ६-१२२-६
translation:
"All these monkeys, without exceptions, have accomplished their task. Reward their
achievement with gifts of gold and precious stones."

sanskrit:
एवम् संमानिताश्चैते नन्द्यमाना यथा त्वया |

भविष्यन्ति कृतज्ञेन निर्विऋता हरियूथपाः || ६-१२२-७
translation:
"Highly honoured in this way any duly cheered by you, acknowledging their services,
the chiefs of monkey-troops, will feel happy."

sanskrit:
त्यागिनं संग्रहीतारं सानुक्रोशं जितेन्द्रियम् |

सर्वे त्वामभिगच्छन्ति ततः संबोधयामि ते || ६-१२२-८
translation:
"All will come nearer to you, for having possessed this quality of generosity, for
propitiating them, for showing compassion to them and for having subjugated your senses. Hence, I
am reminding you."

sanskrit:
हीनं रतिगुणैः सर्वैरभिहन्तारमाहवे |

सेना त्यजति संविग्ना नृपतिं तं नरेश्वर || ६-१२२-९
translation:
"O king! Feeling agitated, the army deserts that king, who is bereft of all loving
qualities and who merely orders them to kill people in battle."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वानरांस्तान्विभीषणः |

रत्नार्थसंविभागेन सर्वानेवाभ्यपूजयत् || ६-१२२-१०

ततस्तान् पूजितान् दृष्ट्वा रत्नार्थैर्हरियूथपान् |

आरुरोह तदा रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् || ६-१२२-११

अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं लज्जमानां यशस्विनीम् |

लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विक्रान्तेन धनुष्मता || ६-१२२-१२

अब्रवीत्स विमानस्थः पूजयन् सर्ववानरान् |

सुग्रीवं च महावीर्यम् काकुत्स्तः सविभीषणम् || ६-१२२-१३

मित्रकार्यम् कृतमिदं भवद्भिद्वानरर्षभाः |

अनुज्ञाता मया सर्वे यथेष्टम् प्रतिगच्छत || ६-१२२-१४
translation:
"O the foremost of monkeys! This work of a friend has been accomplished by you.
Permitted by me, all of you can go, where you will."

sanskrit:
यत्तु कार्यं वयस्येन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च |

कृतं सुग्रीव तत्सर्वं भवता धर्मभीरुणा || ६-१२२-१५

किष्किन्धां प्रतियाह्यशु स्वसैन्येनाभिसंवृतः |
translation:
"O Sugreeva! All that which ought to be done by an affectionate and service-minded
friend, has been done for your part by you, trembling alive as you are to righteousness.
Accompanied by your army, proceed to Kishkindha at once."

sanskrit:
स्वराज्ये वस लङ्कायां मया दत्ते विभीषण || ६-१२२-१६

न त्वां धर्षयितुं शक्ताः सेन्द्रा अपि दिवौकसः |
translation:
"O Vibhishana! Settle down in your kingdom at Lanka, conferred by me. Even the
celestials including Indra shall not be able to attack you."

sanskrit:
अयोध्यां प्रतियास्यामि राजधानीं पितुर्मम || ६-१२२-१७

अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छमि सर्वानामन्त्रयामि वः |
translation:
" I am going to Ayodhya, the seat of government of my father. I bid adieu to you and
wish to take leave of you all."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तास्तु रामेण हरीन्द्रा हरयस्तथा || ६-१२२-१८

ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः |

अयोध्यां गन्तुमिच्छामः सर्वान् नयतु नो भवान् || ६-१२२-१९

मुद्युक्ता विचरिष्यामो वनान्युपननानि च |
translation:
"We also wish to proceed to Ayodhya. You take all of us there we shall range the
gardens and groves there with rejoice."

sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा त्वामभिषेकार्द्रं कौसल्यामभिवाद्य च || ६-१२२-२०

अचिरादागमिष्यामः स्वगृहान्नृपसत्तम |
translation:
"O the excellent king! Seeing you, drench with ablution (in the coronation ceremony)
and offering our salutations to Kausalya, we shall return to our homes."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तः स धर्मात्मा वानरैः सविभीषणैः || ६-१२२-२१

अब्रवीद्वानरान्रामः ससुग्रीवविभीषणान् |

प्रियाअत्प्रियतरं लब्धं यदहं ससुहृज्जनः || ६-१२२-२२

सर्वैर्भवद्भिः सहितः प्रीतिं लप्स्ये पुरीं गतः |
translation:
"Something more dearer than everything dear will be achieved by me, if I reach
Ayodhya with the host of my friends along with all of you, for, I shall feel delighted."

sanskrit:
क्षिप्रमारोह सुग्रीव विमानं वानरैः सह || ६-१२२-२३

त्वमप्यारोह सामात्यो राक्षसेन्द्र विभीषण |
translation:
"O Sugreeva! Mount the aerial cars quickly, along with the monkeys. O Vibhishana,
the king of demons! You also ascend it, along with your counsellors."

sanskrit:
ततह् स पुष्पकं दिव्यं सुग्रीवः सह वानरैः || ६-१२२-२४

आरुरोह मुदा युक्तः समात्यश्च विभीषणः |

तेष्वारूढेषु सर्वेषु कौबेरम् परमासनम् || ६-१२२-२५

राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातमुत्पपात विहायसम् |

खगतेन मिवानेन हंसयुक्तेन भास्वता || ६-१२२-२६

प्रहृष्टश्चप्रतीतश्च बभौ रामः कुबेरवत् |

ते सर्वे वानरर्क्षश्च राक्षसाश्च महाबलाः || ६-१२२-२७

यथासुखमसंबाधं दिव्ये तस्मिन्नुपाविशन् |

अनुज्ञातन् तु रामेण तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् |

उत्पपात महामेघः श्वसनेनोद्धतो यथा || ६-१२३-१

पातयित्वा ततश्चक्षुः सर्वतो रघुनन्दनः |

अब्रवीन्मैथिलीन् सीतां रामः शशिनिभाननाम् || ६-१२३-२

कैलासशिखराकारे त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम् |

लङ्कामीक्षस्व वैदेहि निर्मितान् विश्वकर्मणा || ६-१२३-३
translation:
"O Seetha! Look at the City of Lanka, resting firmly on the mount of Trikuta,
looking like a peak of Mount Kailasa and built by Viswarakarma, the universal architect."

sanskrit:
एतदायोधनं पश्य मान्सशोणितकर्दमम् |

हरीणान् राक्षसानान् च सीते विशसनं महत् || ६-१२३-४
translation:
"O Seetha! Look at this great battle-field, covered with a mud of flesh and blood as
also a cause for the death of monkeys and demons."

sanskrit:
अत्र दत्तवरः शेते प्रमाथी राक्षसेश्वरः |

तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि रावणो निहतो मया || ६-१२३-५
translation:
"O the large-eyed Seetha! Here lies Ravana, the king of demons, the tormentator of
people, on whom boons were conferred by Brahma and who was killed by me for your sake."

sanskrit:
कुम्भकर्णोअत्र निहतः प्रहस्तश्च निशाचरः |

धूम्राक्षश्चात्र निहतो वानरेण हनूमता || ६-१२३-६
translation:
"Here, Kumbhakarna and Prahasta the demon were killed. Here, Dhumraksha was killed
by Hanuma, the monkey."

sanskrit:
विद्युन्माली हतश्चात्र सुषेणेन महात्मना |

लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिच्चात्र रावणिर्निहतो रणे || ६-१२३-७
translation:
"Here was Vidyunmali killed by the great-souled Sushena and here was Indrajit, the
son of Ravana, killed by Lakshmana in a combat."

sanskrit:
अङ्गदेनात्र निहतो विकटो नाम राक्षसः |

विरूपाक्षश्च दुष्प्रेक्ष्यो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ || ६-१२३-८

अकम्पनश्च निहतो बलिनोअन्ये च राक्षसाः |

त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ || ६-१२३-९
translation:
"Here was killed a demon called Vikata by Angada. Virupaksha, who was disagreeable
to the sight, Mahaparsva, Mahodara, Akampana, Trishiras, Atikaya Devantaka, Narantaka and other
mighty demons were also killed here."

sanskrit:
युद्धोन्मत्तश्च मत्तश्च राक्षसप्रवरावुभौ |

निकुम्भश्चैव कुम्भश्च कुम्भकर्णात्मजौ बली || ६-१२३-१०

वज्रदंष्ट्रश्च दंष्ट्रश्च बहवो राक्षसा हताः |

मकराक्ष्च दुर्धर्षो मया युधि निपातितः || ६-१२३-११
translation:
"Both Yuddonmatta and Matta, the foremost of demons, as also Nikumbha and Kumbha the
sons of Kumbhakarna, as also the strong Vajradamshtra, Damshtra and many demons were killed.
Makaraksha, the most difficult demon to be attacked, was struck down by me in this
battle-field."

sanskrit:
अकम्पनश्च निहतः शोणिताक्षश्च वीर्यवान् |

यूपाक्षश्च प्रजङ्घश्च निहतौ तु म्हाहवे || ६-१२३-१२
translation:
"Akampana was killed in the great battle. The valiant Shonitaksha was also killed.
Yupaksa and Prajangha were killed."

sanskrit:
विद्युज्जिह्वोऽत्र निहतो राक्षसो भीमदर्शनः |

यज्ञशत्रुश्च निहतः सुप्तघ्नश्च महाबलः || ६-१२३-१३

सूर्यशत्रुश्च निहतो ब्रह्मशत्रुस्तथापरः |
translation:
"Here, Vidyujjihva, the demon was a terrific appearance, was killed. Yajnashatru
also was killed. The mighty Suptaghna was killed. Surya shatru was killed and another demon called
Brahma shatru was too killed."

sanskrit:
अत्र मन्दोदरी नाम भार्या तं पर्यदेवयत् || ६-१२३-१४

सपत्नीनान् सहस्रेण सास्रेण परिवारिता |
translation:
"Here, surrounded by more than a thousand fellow-wives, Ravana's wife named
Mandodari lamented for Ravana."

sanskrit:
एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थन् समुद्रस्य वरानने || ६-१२३-१५

यत्र सागरमुत्तीर्य तान् रात्रिमुषिता वयम् |
translation:
"O Seetha, the lovely-faced one! Here is seen a water-descent of the ocean on the
sea-shore, where having crossed the ocean, we spent that night."

sanskrit:
एष सेतुर्मया बद्धः सागरे सलिलार्णवे || ६-१२३-१६

तवहेतोर्विशालाक्षि नलसेतुः सुदुष्करः |
translation:
"O the large-eyed Seetha! Here is the bridge called Nala Setu, which was so
difficult to execute for others, got built by me over the salt-sea for your sake."

sanskrit:
पश्य सागरमक्षोभ्यन् वैदेहि वरुणालयम् || ६-१२३-१७

अपारमभिगर्जन्तन् शङ्खशुक्तिनिषेवितम् |
translation:
"O Seetha! See this roaring imperturbable and seemingly boundless ocean, the
habitation of Varuna (the god of waters), which is teeming well with couches and
oyster-shells."

sanskrit:
हिरण्यनाभन् शैलेन्द्रन् काञ्चनं पश्य मैथिलि || ६-१२३-१८

विश्रमार्थन् हनुमतो भित्त्वा सागरमुत्थितम् |
translation:
"O Seetha! See the golden mountain, Mainaka (the ruler of mountains) which rose
passing through the ocean, in order to provide rest and relaxation to Hanuma."

sanskrit:
एतत् कुक्षौ समुद्रस्य स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम् || ६-१२३-१९

अत्र पूर्वं महादेवः प्रसादमकरोत्प्रभुः |
translation:
"See this island, located in the middle of the ocean, where my troops were
stationed. At this place, the lord Shiva (the supreme deity) formerly bestowed his grace on
me."

sanskrit:
एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थं सागरस्य महात्मनः || ६-१२३-२०

सेतुबन्ध इति ख्यातं त्रैलोक्येन च पूजितम् |

एतत्पवित्रं परमं महापातकनाशनम् || ६-१२३-२१

अत्र राक्षसराजोऽयमाजगाम विभीषणः |
translation:
"Here is seen the water-descent of the gigantic ocean, called a Setubandha, adored
in all the three worlds. This is very much a sacred spot, capable of washing away major sins. At
this very place, Vibhishana the king of demons first came."

sanskrit:
एषा सा दृश्यते सीते किष्किन्धा चित्रकानना || ६-१२३-२२

सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या यत्र वाली मया हतः |
translation:
"O Seetha! Here is seen the beautiful City of Sugreeva, Kishkindha, which is full of
colourful groves, where Vali was killed by me."

sanskrit:
अथ दृष्ट्वा पुरीं सीता किष्किन्धां वालिपालिताम् || ६-१२३-२३

अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं रामं प्रणयसाध्वसा |

सुग्रीवप्रियभार्याभिस्ताराप्रमुखातो नृप || ६-१२३-२४

अन्येषां वानरेन्द्राणां स्त्रीभिः परिवृता ह्यहम् |

गन्तुमिच्छे सहायोध्यां राजधानीं त्वया सह || ६-१२३-२५
translation:
"O king! I wish to reach the capital City of Ayodhya along with you, accompanied by
the wives of other monkey-chiefs with Tara and other beloved wives of Sugreeva."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तोऽथ वैदेह्या राघवः प्रत्युवाच ताम् |

एवमस्त्विति किष्किन्धां प्राप्य संस्थाप्य राघवः || ६-१२३-२६

विमानं प्रेक्ष्य सुग्रीवं काक्यमेतदुवाच ह |

ब्रूहि वानरशार्दूल सरान् वानरपुङ्गवान् || ६-१२३-२७

स्त्रीभिः परिवृताह् सर्वे ह्ययोध्यां यान्तु सीतया |
translation:
"O the king of monkeys! Instruct all the monkey-chiefs to come to Ayodhya in the
company of their wives."

sanskrit:
तथा त्वमपि सर्वाभिः स्त्रीभिः सह महाबल || ६-१२३-२८

अभित्वरस्व सुग्रीव गच्छामः प्लवगाधिप |
translation:
"O the mighty Sugreeva, the King of monkeys! You too hasten to depart, taking the
wives of all the monkeys "we shall proceed."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणामिततेजसा || ६-१२३-२९

वानराधिपतिः श्रीमांस्तैश्च सर्वैः समावृतः |

प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं शीघ्रम् तारामुद्वीक्ष्य सोऽब्रवीत् || ६-१२३-३०

प्रिये त्वं सहनारीभिर्वानराणां महात्मनाम् |

राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता मैथिलीप्रियकाम्यया || ६-१२३-३१
translation:
"O the beloved lady! You have been permitted by Rama to proceed to Ayodhya, in the
company of the wives of the great-souled monkeys, with an intent to gratify Seetha."

sanskrit:
त्वर त्वमभिगच्छामो गृह्य वानरयोषितः |

अयोध्यां दर्शयिष्यामः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः || ६-१२३-३२
translation:
"You hurry up, to proceed to Ayodhya, with the wives of the monkeys. We shall show
Ayodhya and all the widows of Dasaratha to them."

sanskrit:
सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारा सर्वाङ्गशोभना |

आहूय चाब्रवीत्सर्वा वानराणां तु योषितः || ६-१२३-३३

सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता गन्तुं सर्वैश्च वानरैः |

मम चापि प्रियं कार्यमयोध्यादर्शनेन च || ६-१२३-३४
translation:
"Duly permitted by Sugreeva and all the monkeys, hurry up to proceed to Ayodhya. A
kindly act will be done to me too, through the sight of Ayodhya (which is so dear to me)."

sanskrit:
प्रवेशम् चैव रामस्य पौरजानपदैः सह |

विभूतिं चैव सर्वासां स्त्रीणां दशरथस्य च || ६-१२३-३५
translation:
"We shall also see the entry of Rama into Ayodhya, along with the people of that
city as well as the inhabitants of the country-side, as also the affluence of the widows of
Dasaratha."

sanskrit:
तारया चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः सर्वा वानरयोषितः |

नेपथ्यविधिपूर्वं तु कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम् || ६-१२३-३६

अध्यारोहन्विमानं तत्सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षया |

ताभिः सहोत्थितं शीघ्रं विमानं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः || ६-१२३-३७

ऋष्यमूकसमीपे तु वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत् |

दृश्यतेअसौ महान्सीते सविद्युदिव तोयदः || ६-१२३-३८

ऋश्यमूको गिरिश्रेष्ठः काञ्चनैर्धातुभिर्वृतः |
translation:
"O Seetha! Here is seen Rishyamuka, the excellent mountain, endowed with layers of
gold and looking like a cloud with lightning."

sanskrit:
अत्राहन् वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण समागतः || ६-१२३-३९

समयश्च कृतः सीते वधार्थन् वालिनो मया |
translation:
"O Seetha! Here did I meet Sugreeva, the king of monkeys and an agreement too was
made by me for the killing of Vali."

sanskrit:
एषा सा दृश्यते पम्पा नलिनी चित्रकानना || ६-१२३-४०

त्वया विहीनो यत्राहन् विललाप सुदुःखितः |
translation:
"Here is seen Pampa-river, abounding in lotuses and edged with colourful groves,
where I lamented with great pain, having been separated from you."

sanskrit:
अस्यास्तीरे मया दृष्टा शबरी धर्मचारिणी || ६-१२३-४१

अत्र योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो निहतो मया |
translation:
"The virtuous Shabari was seen by me at the bank of this river. Here was killed,
Kabandha, having arms, a Yojana (eight miles) long."

sanskrit:
दृश्यतेअसौ जनस्थाने सीते श्रीमान्वनस्पतिः || ६-१२३-४२

यत्र युद्धं महद्वृत्तन् तवहेतोर्विलासिनि |

रावणेन हतो यत्र पक्षिणां प्रवरो बली || ६-१२३-४३
translation:
"And over there is seen in the forest of Janasthana, O Seetha, that illustrious tree
under which the highly brilliant and mighty Jatayu, the foremost among the birds, was killed by
Ravana, for your sake, O sporting lady!."

sanskrit:
खरश्च निहतश्सङ्ख्ये दूषणश्च निपातितः |

त्रिशिराश्च महावीर्यो मया बाणैरजिह्मगैः || ६-१२३-४४

पर्णशाला तथा चित्रा दृश्यते शुभदर्शना |

यत्र त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन हृता बलात् || ६-१२३-४५
translation:
"O lady of beautiful complexion! Here is the region, (known as Panchavati, so called
because it consists of five banyan trees) where Khara the demon was killed by me with
straight-going arrows, as also his brothers, Dushana and the mighty Trishiras. And over there is
seen our enchanting leaf-hut, wh

sanskrit:
एषा गोदावरी रम्या प्रसन्नसलिला शिवा || ६-१२३-४६

अगस्त्यस्याश्रमो ह्येष दृश्यते कदलीवृतः |
translation:
"Here is the shining hermitage of Sutikshna, the great-souled sage. And over there
is seen the great hermitage of Sharabhanga, where the thousand-eyed Indra, the destroyer of
Citadels, came."

sanskrit:
दीप्तश्चैवाश्रमो ह्येष सुतीक्ष्णस्य महात्मनः || ६-१२३-४७

दृश्यते चैव शरभङ्गाश्रमो महान् |

उपयातः सहस्राक्षो यत्र शक्रः पुरन्दरः || ६-१२३-४८
translation:
"Here is the shining hermitage of Sutikshna, the great-souled sage. And over there
is seen the great hermitage of Sharabhanga, where the thousand-eed Indra, the destroyer of
Citadels, came."

sanskrit:
एते ते तापसावासा दृश्यन्ते तनुमध्यमे |

अत्रिः कुलपतिर्यत्र सूर्यवैश्वानरप्रभः || ६-१२३-४९
translation:
"O slender-waisted lady! Here are seen those sages, where, Atri the head of the
hermitage, was equal in splendour to the sun and the fire."

sanskrit:
अस्मिन्देशे महाकायो विराधो निहतो मया |

अत्र सीते त्वया दृष्टा तापसी धर्मचारिणी || ६-१२३-५०
translation:
"At this place, the gigantic Viradha was killed by me. O Seetha! Here was seen by
you, the virtuous Anasuya, the ascetic lady (the wife of sage, Atri)."

sanskrit:
असौ सुतनुशैलेन्द्रश्चित्रकूटः प्रकाशते |

यत्र मान् कैकयीपुत्रः प्रसादयितुमागतः || ६-१२३-५१
translation:
"O Seetha, having a beautiful body! Here is Chitrakuta, the excellent mountain,
shining. Bharata came here to seek my favour (in the form of my consent to return to Ayodhya)."

sanskrit:
एषा सा यमुना दूराद्दृश्यते चित्रकानना |

भरद्वाजाश्रमो श्रीमानेष दृश्यते चैष मैथिलि || ६-१२३-५२
translation:
"O Seetha! Here is seen the beautiful river of Yamuna, surrounded by colourful
groves. Here is seen the illustrious hermitage of Sage Bharadwaja."

sanskrit:
इयं च दृश्यते गङ्गा पुण्या त्रिपथगा नदी |

नानाद्विजगणाकीर्णा संप्रपुष्पितकानना || ६-१२३-५३
translation:
"Here is seen the holy River Ganga, which wends its way through the three worlds
(viz. heaven, the earth and the subterranean world), whose banks are crowded with flocks of birds
and which is lined with trees in full-flowering."

sanskrit:
शृङ्गवेरपुरन् चैतद्गुहो यत्र समागतः |

एषा त्रिपथगा गङ्गा दृश्यते वरवर्णिनि || ६-१२३-५४

नानातरुशताकीर्णा संप्रपुष्पितकानना |
translation:
"Here is the town of Shringaberapura, where Guha my friend stays. Here is seen that
river, Sarayu, lined with rows of sacrificial posts (the relics of sacrifices performed from time
to time by Ikshvaku dynasty), bordered with hundreds of trees and with groves in full blossom."

sanskrit:
एषा सा दृश्यतेअयोध्या राजधानी पितुर्मम || ६-१२३-५५

अयोध्यान् कुरु वैदेहि प्रणामं पुनरागता |
translation:
"O Seetha! Here is seen that Capital City of my father. O the princess of Videha
territory! Having duly returned, offer your salutation to Ayodhya."

sanskrit:
ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः || ६-१२३-५६

उत्पत्योत्पत्य ददृशुस्तां पुरीन् शुभदर्शनाम् |

ततस्तु तां पाण्डुरहर्म्यमालिनीं |

विशालकक्ष्यान् गजवाजिसङ्कुलाम् |

पुरीमयोध्यान् ददृशुः प्लवङ्गमाः |

पुरीं महेन्द्रस्य यथामरावतीम् || ६-१२३-५७

पूर्णे चतुर्दशे वर्षे पञ्चम्यां लक्ष्मणाग्रजः |

भरद्वाजाश्रमं प्राप्य ववन्दे नियतो मुनिम् || ६-१२४-१

सोऽपृच्छदभिवाद्यैनं भरद्वाजं तपोधनम् |

शृणोषि कच्चिद्भगवन् सुभिक्षानामयं पुरे || ६-१२४-२

कच्चित्स युक्तो भरतो जीवन्त्यपि च मातरः |

एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण भरद्वाजो महामुनिः || ६-१२४-३

प्रत्युवाच रघुश्रेष्ठं स्मितपूर्वं प्रहृष्टवत् |

पङ्कदिग्धस्तु भरतो जटिलस्त्वां प्रतीक्षते || ६-१२४-४

पादुके ते पुरस्कृत्य सर्वं च कुशलं गृहे |
translation:
"Bharata, with his mud-smeared limbs 9throwing the burden and blame ie. mud and with
matted locks, as also placing your wooden-sandals before him, is looking forward for your arrival.
All are safe at your home and in the city."

sanskrit:
त्वां पुरा चीरवसनं प्रविशन्तं महावनम् || ६-१२४-५

स्त्रीतृतीयं च्युतं राज्याद्धर्मकामं च केवलम् |

पदातिं त्यक्तसर्वस्वं पितृनिर्देशकारिणम् || ६-१२४-६

सर्वभोगैः परित्यक्तं स्वर्गच्युतम्वामरम् |

दृष्
translation:
"O Rama, the victorious in battles! Formerly, on seeing you penetrating deeply into
the great forest on foot, with the sole intention of practicing virtue, clad in pieces of bark,
going away from sovereignty, deprived of all enjoyments, like an immortal fallen from heaven,
having renounced all your

sanskrit:
सांप्रतम् तु समृद्धार्थं समित्रगणबान्धवम् || ६-१२४-८

समीक्ष्य विजितारिं च ममाभूत्प्रीतिरुत्तमा |
translation:
"But now, a great delight occurred to me, on seeing you, having fulfilled your
purpose, that you have conquered your enemies and are accompanied by your host of friends and
relatives."

sanskrit:
सर्वं च सुखकुःखं ते विदितं ममम् राघव |

यत्त्वया विपुलं प्राप्तं जनस्थाननिवासिना || ६-१२४-९
translation:
"That joy and sorrow experienced by you in abundance while residing in
Janasthana-forest in completely known to me, O Rama!"

sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणार्थे नियुक्तस्य रक्षतः सर्वतापसान् |

रावणेन हृता भार्या बभूवेयमनिन्दिता || ६-१२४-१०
translation:
"While you were busy in protecting all the ascetics who prayed you for safeguarding
the interests of Brahmanas, this irreproachable wife of yours was taken away by Ravana."

sanskrit:
मारीचदर्शनं चैव सीतोन्मथनमेव च |

कबन्धदर्शनं चैव पम्पाभिगमनं तथा || ६-१२४-११

सुग्रीवेण च ते सख्यं यथा वाली हतस्त्वया |

मार्गणं चैव वैदेह्याः कर्म वातात्मजस्य च || ६-१२४-१२

विदितायां च सीतायां नलसे
translation:
"O Rama, devoted to virtue! Even the appearance of Mareecha, the abduction of Seetha
by Ravana, the sight of Kabandha, your arrival at the Pampa lake, your alliance with Sugreeva, how
Vali was killed by you, the search-operation for Seetha, the exploit of Hanuma, the tracing of
Seetha, how the bridg

sanskrit:
मित्राणि धन धान्यानि प्रजानां सम्मतानिव |

जननी नन्म भूमिश्च स्वर्गादपि गरीयसी || ६-१२४-१७
translation:
"The friends, the riches and the grains are highly honoured in this world. Mother
and mother-land are far superior to even the heaven."

sanskrit:
तस्य तच्छिरसा वाक्यं प्रतिगृह्य नृपात्मजः |

बाढमित्येव संहृष्टः श्रीमान्वरमयाचत || ६-१२४-१८

अकालफलिनो वृक्षाः सर्वे चापि मधुस्रवाः |

फलान्यमृतगन्धीनि बहूनि विविधानि च || ६-१२४-१९

भवन्तु मार्गे भवन्नयोध्यां प्रति गच्छतः |
translation:
"O venerable sir! Let all the trees on the way, even as I fly to Ayodhya, bear fruit
even in the off-season and flow with honey. Let abundant fruits of various kinds, emitting the
fragrance of nectar, appear on them."

sanskrit:
तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाते वचनात्समनन्तरम् || ६-१२४-२०

अभवन्पादपास्तत्र स्वर्गपादपसंनिभाः |

निष्फलाः फलिनश्चासन्विपुष्पाः पुष्पशालिनः || ६-१२४-२१

शुष्काः समग्रपत्रास्ते नगाश्चैव मधुस्रवाः |

सर्वतो योजनास्त्रिस्रो गच्छतामभवंस्तदा || ६-१२४-२२

ततः प्रहृष्टाः प्लवगर्षभास्ते |

बहूनि दिव्यानि फलानि चैव |

कामादुपाश्नन्ति सहस्रशस्ते |

मुदान्विताः स्वर्गजितो मुदेव || ६-१२४-२३

अयोध्यां तु समालोक्य चिन्तयामास राघवः |

प्रियकामः प्रियं रामस्ततस्त्वरितविक्रमम्

अयोध्यां तु समालोक्य चिन्तयामास राघवः |

प्रियकामः प्रियं रामस्ततस्त्वरितविक्रमः || ६-१२५-१

चिन्तयित्वा ततो दृष्टिं वानरेषु न्यपातयत् |

उवाच धीमांस्तेजस्वी हनूमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम् || ६-१२५-२

अयोध्यां त्वरितो गच्छ क्षिप्रं त्वं प्लवगोत्तम |

जानीहि कच्चित्कुशली जनो नृपतिमन्दिरे || ६-१२५-३
translation:
"O the foremost of the monkeys! Going with all speed to Ayodhya, find out whether
the people there, are safe in the royal palace.

sanskrit:
शृङ्गवेरपुरं प्राप्य गुहं गहनगोचरम् |

निषादाधिपतिं ब्रूहि कुशलं वचनान्मम || ६-१२५-४
translation:
"Reaching then to Shrigaberapura, communicate in my name, about my welfare to Guha,
the king of Nishadas, a wild tribe living in the forest."

sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु मां कुशलिनमरोगं विगतज्वरम् |

अविष्यति गुहः प्रीतः स ममात्मसमः सखा || ६-१२५-५
translation:
"Guha will be pleased to hear about me, as being safe, healthy and free from
trouble. He is my friend, as well as my own self."

sanskrit:
अयोध्यायाश्च ते मार्गं प्रवृत्तिं भरतस्य च |

निवेदयिष्यति प्रीतो निषादाधिपतिर्गुहः || ६-१२५-६

भरतस्तु त्वया वाच्यः कुशलं वचनान्मम |

सिद्धार्थं शंस मां तस्मै सभार्यं सहलक्ष्मणम् || ६-१२५-७
translation:
"Bharata too is to be asked by you, the news about his welfare, in my name. Tell him
of me as having returned, accomplished of our object, with my consort and Lakshmana."

sanskrit:
हरणं चापि वैदेह्या रावणेन बलीयसा |

सुग्रीवेण च संवादं वालिनश्च वधं रणे || ६-१२५-८
translation:
"Tell him about the abduction of Seetha by the mighty Ravana, my conversation with
Sugreeva and the killing of Vali in combat."

sanskrit:
मैथिल्यन्वेषणं चैव यथा चाधिगता त्वया |

लङ्घयित्वा महातोयमापगापतिमव्ययम् || ६-१२५-९
translation:
"Tell him also about the search for Seetha and how she was traced out by you, after
crossing the never-diminishing ocean, having extensive waters."

sanskrit:
उपयानं समुद्रस्य सागरस्य च दर्शनम् |

यथा च कारितः सेतू रावणश्च यथा हतः || ६-१२५-१०
translation:
"Tell him about our going near the ocean, the appearance of the ocean, how the
bridge was constructed there and how Ravana was killed."

sanskrit:
वरदानं महेन्द्रेण ब्रह्मणा वरुणेन च |

महादेवप्रसादाच्च पित्रा मम समागमम् || ६-१२५-११
translation:
"Tell him about the bestower of boons by Indra the lord of celestials, by brahma the
lord of creation, and by Varuna the lord of waters, my meeting with my (deceased) father, through
the grace of Shiva the Supreme Deity."

sanskrit:
उपयातं च मां सौम्य भरताय निवेदय |

सह राक्षसराजेन हरीणामीश्वरेण च || ६-१२५-१२
translation:
"O gentle Hanuma! Inform to Bharata, of me as having come near Ayodhya, along with
Vibhishana and Sugreeva the lord of monkeys."

sanskrit:
जित्वा शत्रुगणान्रामः प्राप्य चानुत्तमं यशः |

उपयाति समृद्धार्थः सह मित्रैर्महाबलः || ६-१२५-१३
translation:
"Tell him, that having conquered hosts of enemies and obtained an excellent fame, is
purpose having been accomplished, Rama is coming near, with is mighty friends."

sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा यमाकारं भजते भरतस्ततः |

स च ते वेदितव्यः स्यात्सर्वं यच्चापि मां प्रति || ६-१२५-१४
translation:
"It is also to be observed by you, about the facial expression which Bharata wears,
after hearing all this and also all that he intends to do in relation to me."

sanskrit:
ज्ञेयाः सर्वे च वृत्तान्ता भरतस्येङ्गितानि च |

तत्त्वेन मुखवर्णेन दृष्ट्या व्याभाषणेन च || ६-१२५-१५
translation:
"All the occurrences there are to be known. All the gestures of Bharata are to be
ascertained through the colour of his face, glances and the speech."

sanskrit:
सर्वकामसमृद्धं हि हस्त्यश्वरथसङ्कुलम् |

पितृपैतामहं राज्यं कस्य नावर्तयेन्मनः || ६-१२५-१६
translation:
"Whose mind does not turn round, with a kingdom abundantly rich in all coveted
enjoyments, teeming with elephants horses and chariots and which is in herited from one's
father?"

sanskrit:
संगत्या भरतः श्रीमान्राज्येनार्थी स्वयं भवेत् |

प्रशास्तु वसुधां सर्वामखिलां रघुनन्दनः || ६-१२५-१७
translation:
"Having been associated with the kingdom for long, if the illustrious Bharata is
longing for it himself, let Bharata rule the entire kingdom in one piece."

sanskrit:
तस्य बुद्धिं च विज्ञाय व्यवसायं च वानर |

यावन्न दूरं याताः स्मः क्षिप्रमागन्तुमर्हसि || ६-१२५-१८
translation:
"O Hanuma! Understanding his mind and perception, you ought to return quickly,
before we are not gone for a long distance towards Ayodhya."

sanskrit:
इति प्रतिसमादिष्टो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः |

मानुषं धारयन्रूपमयोध्यां त्वरितो ययौ || ६-१२५-१९

अथोत्पपात वेगेन हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः |

गरुत्मानिव वेगेन जिघृक्षन् पन्नगोत्तमम् || ६-१२५-२०

लङ्घयित्वा पितृपथं भुजगेन्द्रालयं शुभम् |

गङ्गायमुनयोर्भीमं संनिपातमतीत्य च || ६-१२५-२१

शृङ्गवेरपुरं प्राप्य गुहमासाद्य वीर्यवान् |

स वाचा शुभया हृष्टो हनूमानिदमब्रवीत् || ६-१२५-२२

सखा तु तव काकुत्स्थो रामः सत्यपराक्रमः |

ससीतः सह सौमित्रिः स त्वां कुशलमब्रवीत् || ६-१२५-२३
translation:
"Along with Seetha and Lakshmana, Rama, your friend, that scion of Kakutthsa, of
true prowess, has for his part enquired of your welfare."

sanskrit:
पञ्चमीमद्य रजनीमुषित्वा वचनान्मुनेः |

भरद्वाजाभ्यनुज्ञातं द्रक्ष्यस्यद्यैव राघवम् || ६-१२५-२४
translation:
"You can see Rama here itself today, when he has been duly permitted by Bharadwaja
the sage, after spending, at the instance of the sage, for a night of the fifth lunar day (of the
bright half of the month of Ashvayuja)."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः |

उत्पपात महावेगो वेगवानविचारयन् || ६-१२५-२५

सोऽपश्यद्रामतीर्थं च नदीं वालुकिनीं तथा |

वरूथीं गोमतीं चैव भीमं सालवनं तथा || ६-१२५-२६

प्रजाश्च बहुसाहस्रीः स्फीतान् जनपदानपि |

स गत्वा दूरमध्वानं त्वरितः कपिकुञ्जरः || ६-१२५-२७

आससाद द्रुमान्फुल्लान्नन्दिग्रामसमीपजान् |

सुराधिपस्योपवने यथा चैत्ररथे द्रुमान् || ६-१२५-२८

स्त्रीभिः सपुत्रैर्वृद्धैश्च रममाणैः स्वलंकृतैः |

क्रोशमात्रे त्वयोध्यायाश्चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम् || ६-१२५-२९

ददर्श भरतं दीनं कृशमाश्रमवासिनम् |

जटिलं मलदिग्धाङ्गं भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितम् || ६-१२५-३०

फलमूलाशिनं दान्तं तापसं धर्मचारिणम् |

समुन्नतजटाभारं

न हि ते राजपुत्रं तं चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम् || ६-१२५-३४

परिमोक्तुं व्यवस्यन्ति पौरा वै धर्मवत्सलाः |

तं धर्ममिव धर्मज्ञं देववन्तमिवापरम् || ६-१२५-३५

उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाकय्ं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः |

वसन्तं दण्डकारण्ये यं त्वं चीरजटाधरम् || ६-१२५-३६

अनुशोचसि काकुत्स्थं स त्वा कुशलमब्रवीत् |
translation:
"Rama, for whom you are repenting residing as he was in the forest of Dandaka
wearing the bark of trees and matted locks, has enquired about your welfare."

sanskrit:
प्रियमाख्यामि ते देव शोकं त्यक्ष्यसि दारुणम् || ६-१२५-३७

अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते भ्रात्रा त्वं रामेण सह सङ्गतः |
translation:
"O Lord! I am telling you a pleasant news. Give up this dreadful anguish. Within a
while, you will be meeting Rama, your elder brother."

sanskrit:
निहत्य रावणं रामः प्रतिलभ्य च मैथिलीम् || ६-१२५-३८

उपयाति समृद्धार्थः सह मित्रैर्महाबलैः |
translation:
"Having killed Ravana and got back Seetha, Rama is returning with his mighty
friends, his purpose duly accomplished."

sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजा वैदेही च यशस्विनी || ६-१२५-३९

सीता समग्रा रामेण महेन्द्रेण शची यथा |
translation:
"Lakshmana too, who is endowed with extraordinary energy, is coming intact with
Seetha, the illustrious princess of Videha territory and with Rama as Sachi (the wife of Indra)
would with the mighty Indra the lord of celestials."

sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो हनुमता भरतः कैकयीसुतः || ६-१२५-४०

पपात सहसा हृष्टो हर्षान्मोहमुपागमत् |

ततो मुहूर्तादुत्थाय प्रत्याश्वस्य च राघवः || ६-१२५-४१

हनुमन्तमुवाचेदं भरतः प्रियवादिनम् |

अशोकजैः प्रीतिमयैः कपिमालिङ्ग्य सम्भ्रमात् || ६-१२५-४२

सिषेच भरतः श्रीमान् विपुलैरश्रुबिन्दुभिः |

देवो वा मानुषो वा त्वमनुक्रोशादिहागतः || ६-१२५-४३

प्रियाख्यानस्य ते सौम्य ददामि ब्रुवतः प्रियम् |

गवां शतसहस्रं च ग्रामाणां च शतं परम् || ६-१२५-४४

सकुण्डलाः शुभाचारा भार्याः कन्याश्च षोडश |

हेमवर्
translation:
"O the gentle one! Are you a divine being or a human being, who have come here out
of compassion? To you, who have given this agreeable news to me, I shall give in return, for the
pleasant tidings, a hundred thousand cows, a hundred best villages, and for wives, sixteen golden
complexioned virgin gi

sanskrit:
निशम्य रामागमनं नृपात्मजः |

कपिप्रवीरस्य तदाद्भुतोपमम् |

प्रहर्षितो रामदिदृक्षयाभवत् |

पुनश्च हर्षादिदमब्रवीद्वचः || ६-१२५-४६

बहूनि नाम वर्षाणि गतस्य सुमहद्वनम् |

शृणोम्यहं प्रीतिकरं मम नाथस्य कीर्तनम् || ६-१२६-१
translation:
"I am indeed hearing a delight mention of my lord, who proceeded to the vast forest
so many years ago.

sanskrit:
कल्याणी बत गाथेयं लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मे |

एति जीवन्तमानन्दो नरं वर्षशतादपि || ६-१२६-२
translation:
"This common saying sounds to me good, that bliss comes to a surviving man, even if
it be after a hundred years!"

sanskrit:
राघवस्य हरीणां च कथमासीत्समागमः |

कस्मिन्देशे किमाश्रित्य तत्त्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः || ६-१२६-३
translation:
"How and on what ground, an alliance has been concluded between Rama and the monkeys
and at what place? Tell the truth to me, enquiring as I am."

sanskrit:
स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण बृस्यां समुपवेशितः |

आचचक्षे ततः सर्वं रामस्य चरितं वने || ६-१२६-४

यथा प्रव्रजितो रामो मातुर्दत्ते वरे तव |

यथा च पुत्रशोकेन राजा दशरथो मृतः || ६-१२६-५

यथा दूतैस्त्वमानीतस्तूर्णं राजगृहात्प्रभो |

त्वयायोध्यां प्रविष्टेन यथा राज्यं न चेप्सितम् || ६-१२६-६

चित्रकूटं
translation:
"O Lord, the long-armed! How your mother was conferred with two boons by your
father, how Rama was sent to exile, how Dasaratha the king died, with a shocking sorrow for his
son's exile, how you were brought quickly from Rajagriha (the seat of government of Kekaya kings)
by the envoys, how sovereign

sanskrit:
अपयाते त्वयि तदा समुद्भ्रान्तमृगद्विजम् |

प्रविवेशाथ विजनं सुमहद्दण्डकावनम् || ६-१२६-१०
translation:
"When you had gone away, that forest (of Chitrakuta) then assumed a very miserable
appearance, with the frightened animals and birds (on seeing strange people there)."

sanskrit:
तद्धस्तिमृदितं घोरं सिंहवाग्रमृगाकुलम् |

प्रविवेशाथ विजनं स महद्दण्डकावनम् || ६-१२६-११
translation:
"Rama, thereupon, entered that large, terrific and solitary forest of Dandaka, which
had been trampled by elephants and extensive with lions, tigers and deers."

sanskrit:
तेषां पुरस्ताद्बलवान्गच्छतां गहने वने |

विनदन्सुमहानादं विराधः प्रत्यदृश्यत || ६-१२६-१२
translation:
"In front of them, even as they were going in that dense forest, there appeared
Viradha, a demon, uttering forth a very loud roar.

sanskrit:
तमुत्क्षिप्य महानादमूर्ध्वबाहुमधोमुखम् |

निखाते प्रक्षिपन्ति स्म नदन्तमिव कुञ्जरम् || ६-१२६-१३
translation:
"They cast him, who rushed with uplifted arms towards them, into a pit, turning his
head bent low, and who was emitting a loud cry, like an elephant."

sanskrit:
तत्कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ |

सायाह्ने शरभङ्गस्य रम्यमाश्रममीयतुः || ६-१२६-१४
translation:
"Carrying out that ardous task, Rama and Lakshmana, both the brothers, went to the
beautiful hermitage of Sharbhanga, in that evening.

sanskrit:
शरभङ्गे दिवं प्राप्ते रामः सत्यपराक्रमः |

अभिवाद्य मुनीन्सर्वाञ्जनस्थानमुपागमत् || ६-१२६-१५
translation:
"Offering salutation to all the hermits when Sharabhanga ascended to heaven, Rama
who truly mighty, reached the region of Janasthana."

sanskrit:
पश्चाच्चूर्पणखा नाम रामपार्श्वमुपागता |

ततो रामेण संदिष्टो लक्ष्मणः सहसोत्थितः || ६-१२६-१६

प्रगृह्य खड्गं चिच्छेद कर्णनासे महाबलः |
translation:
"Thereafter, a female-demon called Surpanakha sought the presence of Rama. As
ordered by Rama, the mighty Lakshmana thereupon rose quickly and seizing a sword, chopped off her
ears and nose."

sanskrit:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम् |

हतानि वसता तत्र राघवेण महात्मना || ६-१२६-१७
translation:
"Fourteen thousand demons, inhabiting Janasthana-region, were killed by the
great-souled Rama, while sojourning that region."

sanskrit:
एकेन सह संगम्य रामेण रणमूर्धनि |

अह्नश्चतुर्थभागेन निःशेषा राक्षसाः कृताः || ६-१२६-१८
translation:
"The demons, who came together at the battle-front, were wholly finished by Rama
alone, in a fraction of a quarter of a day."

sanskrit:
महाबला महावीर्यास्तपसो विघ्नकारिणः || ६-१२६-१९

निहता राघवेणाजौ दण्डकारण्यवासिनः |
translation:
"The demons who were the mighty inhabitants of Dandaka-forest, who were causing
obstacles to the austerity of the ascetics, were killed by Rama."

sanskrit:
राक्षसाश्च विनिष्पिष्टाः खरश्च निहतो रणे || ६-१२६-२०

दूषणं चाग्रतो हत्वा त्रिशिरास्तदनन्तम् |
translation:
"The demons were smashed in the battle. Khara (their leader) also was killed. After
killing Dushana (his brother) first, Trishira (the other brother) was killed thereafter."

sanskrit:
ततस्तेनार्दिता बाला रावणं समुपागता || ६-१२६-२१

रावणानुचरो घोरो मारीचो नाम राक्षसः |

लोभयामास वैदेहीं भूत्वा रत्नमयो मृगः || ६-१२६-२२
translation:
"Tormented by the incident of destruction of demons, the foolish Surpanakha sought
refuge with Ravana. Disguised in the form of a deer studded with precious stones, a terrific demon
by name, Maricha, a follower of Ravana, allured Seetha."

sanskrit:
सा राममब्रवीद्दृष्ट्वा वैदेही गृह्यतामिति |

अयं मनोहरह् कान्त आश्रमो नो भविष्यति || ६-१२६-२३
translation:
"That Seetha, on seeing it, told Rama, 'Let this deer be caught. Our hermitage will
turn out to be charming and pleasing to the eye'."

sanskrit:
ततो रामो धनुष्पाणिर्धावन्तमनुधावति |

स तं जघान धावन्तं शरेणानतपर्वणा || ६-१२६-२४
translation:
"Thereupon, Rama wielding a bow in his arm, chased that deer and killed that running
one, with an arrow of curved knots."

sanskrit:
अथ सौम्या दशग्रीवो मृगं याते तु राघवे |

लक्ष्मणे चापि निष्क्रान्ते प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा || ६-१२६-२५
translation:
"O good sir! While Rama was chasing the deer and even when Lakshmana had gone out,
Ravana forthwith entered their hermitage during that interval."

sanskrit:
जग्राह तरसा सीतां ग्रहः खे रोहिणीम् इव |

त्रातुकामं ततो युद्धे हत्वा गृध्रं जटायुषम् || ६-१२६-२६

प्रगृह्य सहसा सीतां जगामाशु स राक्षसः |
translation:
"Ravana, the demon, seized Seetha, even as a planet like Mars would obscure the
constellation, Rohini. Having killed a vulture named Jatayu, who sought to deliver her, Ravana then
went quickly in haste, taking Seetha with him"

sanskrit:
ततस्त्वद्भुतसङ्काशाः स्थिताः पर्वतमूर्धनि || ६-१२६-२७

सीतां गृहीत्वा गच्छन्तं वानराः पर्वतोपमाः |

ददृशुर्विस्मितास्तत्र रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् || ६-१२६-२८
translation:
"Then, in surprise, some monkeys who was staying on a mountain-peak, looking like
mountain, saw, with astonishment writ large in their faces, Ravana the king of demons, passing that
way, taking away Seetha."

sanskrit:
ततः शीघ्रतरं गत्वा तद्विमानं मनोजवम् |

आरुह्य सह वैदेह्या पुष्पकं स महाबलः || ६-१२६-२९

प्रविवेर्श तदा लङ्कां रावणो लोकरावणः |
translation:
"Going still faster and ascending along with Seetha, the aerial car, Pushpaka, which
was as swift as thought, the mighty Ravana the king of demons thereupon entered the City of
Lanka."

sanskrit:
तां सुवर्णपरिक्रान्ते शुभे महति वेश्मनि || ६-१२६-३०

प्रवेश्य मैथिलीं वाक्यैः सान्त्वयामास रावणः |
translation:
"Conducting that Seetha into a large beautiful mansion, embellished with gold, that
Ravana sought to cajole her gently with his words."

sanskrit:
तृणवद्भाषितं तस्य तं च नैरृतपुंगवम् || ६-१२६-३१

अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही ह्यशोकवनिकां गता |
translation:
"Caring a straw for that Ravana and his talk, Seetha, later, actually remained in
Ashoka-grove."

sanskrit:
न्यवर्तत तदा रामो मृगं हत्वा तदा वने || ६-१२६-३२

निवर्तमानः काकुत्स्थो दृष्ट्वा गृध्रं प्रविव्यथे |

गृध्रं हतं तदा दग्ध्वा रामः प्रियसखं पितुः || ६-१२६-३३
translation:
"Having killed that deer, Rama while returning to the hermitage, saw the vulture
(Jatayu) in the forest. Rama was greatly disturbed. Seeing the vulture (Jatayu) who was dearer to
him than his own father killed, Rama was disturbed."

sanskrit:
मार्गमाणस्तु वैदेहीं राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः |

गोदावरीमनुचरन्वनोद्देशांश्च पुष्पितान् || ६-१२६-३४
translation:
"While searching for Seetha, RAma along with Lakshmana strolled after blossomed
woodlands along the bank of Godavari-river."

sanskrit:
आसेदतुर्महारण्ये कबन्धं नाम राक्षसं |

ततः कबन्धवचनाद्रामः सत्यपराक्रमः || ६-१२६-३५

ऋश्यमूकं गिरिं गत्वा सुग्रीवेण समागतः |
translation:
"They met, in that great forest, a demon by name Kabandha. Then according to the
advice of Kabandha, Rama of true prowess met Sugreeva, after heading for Mount Rishyamuka."

sanskrit:
तयोः समागमः पूर्वं प्रीत्या हार्दो व्यजायत || ६-१२६-३६

इतरेतर संवादात्प्रगाढः प्रणयस्तयोः |

इतरेतरसंवादात्प्रगाढः प्रणयस्तयोः || ६-१२६-३७
translation:
"Even before they met, a meeting of hearts through affinity, had taken place between
them. Sugreeva had been banished in the past by the enraged Vali, his elder brother and as a result
of mutual talks, affection deeply arose between Rama and Sugreeva."

sanskrit:
रामः स्वबाहुवीर्येण स्वराज्यं प्रत्यपादयत् |

वालिनं समरे हत्वा महाकायं महाबलम् || ६-१२६-३८
translation:
"Having killed with the strength of his arms in combat, the mighty Vali with a
colossal body, Rama caused the kingdom of Sugreeva restored.

sanskrit:
सुग्रीवः स्थापितो राज्ये सहितः सर्ववानरैः |

रामाय प्रतिजानीते राजपुत्र्यास्तु मार्गणम् || ६-१२६-३९
translation:
"Sugreeva, who was established in his kingdom with all, his monkeys, had given his
pledge to Rama, to commence a search for Seetha the princess."

sanskrit:
आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण महात्मना |

दशकोट्यः प्लवङ्गानां सर्वाः प्रस्थापिता दिशः || ६-१२६-४०
translation:
"Ten crores of monkeys were accordingly commanded by the great-souled Sugreeva and
sent to all the four quarters."

sanskrit:
तेषां नो विप्रनष्टानां विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे |

भृशं शोकाभितप्तानां महान्कालोअत्यवर्तत || ६-१२६-४१
translation:
"Having lost our way in Vindhya, the foremost of mountain-ranges, a long time
slipped past us and we felt sore-stricken with sorrow."

sanskrit:
भ्राता तु गृध्रराजस्य सम्पातिर्नाम वीर्यवान् |

समाख्याति स्म वसतिं सीताया रावणालये || ६-१२६-४२
translation:
"Meanwhile, the brother of Jatayu (the king of vultures), Sampati by name, precisely
communicated to us that Seetha was dwelling in the habitation of Ravana."

sanskrit:
सोअहं दुःखपरीतानां दुःखं तज्ज्ञातिनां नुदन् |

आत्मवीर्यं समास्थाय योजनानां शतं प्लुतः || ६-१२६-४३
translation:
"Removing the grief of my kinsfolk, who were seized with sorrow, I, as such, crossed
one hundred yojanas (eight hundred miles of the ocean), resorting to my own strength."

sanskrit:
तत्राहमेकामद्राक्षमशोकवनिकां गताम् |

कौशेयवस्त्रां मलिनां निरानन्दां दृढव्रताम् || ६-१२६-४४
translation:
"There, I saw Seetha, living alone in a grove of Ashoka trees, clad in a soiled
silk-saree, looking cheerless, but unflinching in her vow."

sanskrit:
तया समेत्य विधिवत्पृष्ट्वा सर्वमनिन्दिताम् |

अभिज्ञानं मया दत्तं रामनामाङ्गुलीयकम् || ६-१२६-४५
translation:
"After meeting her and duly enquiring that faultless Seetha, everything of her, a
ring with the name, Rama engraved on it, was handed-over to her by me as a token."

sanskrit:
अभिज्ञानं मणिं लब्ध्वा चरितार्थोअहमागतः |

मया च पुनरागम्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः || ६-१२६-४६

अभिज्ञानं मया दत्तमर्चिष्मान्स महामणिः |
translation:
"Receiving in return from her, a jewel (from her head), I came back to the northern
shore, successful as I was in my undertaking. On my return, that brilliant and valuable jewel was
given by me as a token to Rama who was unweary in action."

sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तां मैथिलीं हृष्टस्त्वाशशंसे स जीवितम् || ६-१२६-४७

जीवितान्तमनुप्राप्तः पीत्वामृतमिवातुरः |
translation:
"On hearing the news of Seetha, Rama for his part regained the hope to survive, as a
dying patient would, on drinking the ambrosia."

sanskrit:
उद्योजयिष्यन्नुद्योगं दध्रे लङ्कावधे मनः || ६-१२६-४८

जिघांसुरिव लोकांस्ते सर्वांल्लोकान्विभावसुः |
translation:
"Excited as he was to put forth a war-effort, he set his mind on the destruction of
Lanka, as the fire-god intending to destroy all the three worlds, would, at the end of the
universe."

sanskrit:
ततः समुद्रमासाद्य नलं सेतुमकारयत् || ६-१२६-४९

अतरत्कपिवीराणां वाहिनी तेन सेतुना |
translation:
"Then, on reaching the ocean, he got a bridge constructed by Nala and through that
bridge, the army of the valiant monkeys crossed the ocean."

sanskrit:
प्रहस्तमवधीन्नीलः कुम्भकर्णं तु राघवः || ६-१२६-५०

लक्ष्मणो रावणसुतं स्वयं रामस्तु रावणम् |
translation:
"Neela killed Prahasta. Rama, the scion of Raghu dynasty, personally killed
Kumbhakarna and Ravana. Lakshmana killed Indrajit, the son of Ravana."

sanskrit:
स शक्रेण समागम्य यमेन वरुणेन च || ६-१२६-५१

महेश्वरस्वयम्भूभ्यां तथा दशरथेन च |

तैश्च काकुत्थ्सो वरान् लेभे परंतपः || ६-१२६-५२

सुरर्षिभिश्च काकुत्स्थो वरांल्लेभे परन्तपः |
translation:
"The illustrious Rama, the destroyer of enemies, happened to meet Indra the lord of
celestials, Yama the lord of dissolution, Varuna the lord of waters, Maheshvara, the great lord
(Shiva), Brahma the lord of creation as also Dasaratha (his deceased father) and was bestowed boons
by them. Sages and c

sanskrit:
स तु दत्तवरः प्रीत्या वानरैश्च समागतः || ६-१२६-५३

पुष्पकेण विमानेन किष्किन्धामभ्युपागमत् |
translation:
"Having been granted boons, Rama for his part flew to Kishkindha in an aerial car
called Pushpaka, along with the monkeys who gathered there."

sanskrit:
तं गङ्गां पुनरासाद्य वसन्तं मुनिसंनिधौ || ६-१२६-५४

अविघ्नं पुष्ययोगेन श्वो रामं द्रष्टुमर्हसि |
translation:
"Reaching the coast-line of Ganga-river again, Rama is staying in the presence of
the sage, Bharadwaja. Tomorrow, when the moon will be in conjunction with the asteroid, Pushya you
will be able to see Rama, without any obstacle."

sanskrit:
ततः स सत्यं हनुमद्वचो महन् |

निशम्य हृष्टो भरतः कृताञ्जलिः |

उवाच वाणीं मनसः प्रहर्षिणी |

चिरस्य पूर्णः खलु मे मनोरथः || ६-१२६-५५
translation:
"Gladdened to hear Rama's impending return to Ayodhya in the sweet words of Hanuma,
Bharata offered his salutation by joining his palms together and spoke the following words, which
enraptured his mind: 'My desire has been fulfilled indeed after a long time'."

sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु परमानन्दं भरतः सत्यविक्रमः |

हृष्टमाज्ञापयामास शत्रुघ्नं परवीरहा || ६-१२७-१
translation:
"Hearing the news of a great happiness from Hanuma, Bharata the truly brave ruler
and the destroyer of enemies, commanded (as follows) to Shatrughna, who too felt delighted at the
news."

sanskrit:
दैवतानि च सर्वाणि चैत्यानि नगरस्य च |

सुगन्धमाल्यैर्वादित्रैरर्चन्तु शुचयो नराः || ६-१२७-२
translation:
"Let men of good conduct, offer worship to their family-deities, sanctuaries in the
city with sweet-smelling flowers and to the accompaniment of musical instruments."

sanskrit:
सूताः स्तुतिपुराणज्ञाह् सर्वे वैतालिकास्तथा |

सर्वे वादित्रकुशला गणिकाश्चैव संघशः || ६-१२७-३

राजदारास्तथामात्याः सैन्याः सेनागणाङ्गनाः |

ब्राह्मणाश्च सराजन्याः श्रेणिमुख्यास्तथा गणाः || ६-१२७-४

अभ
translation:
"Let bards well-versed in singing praises and Puranas (containing ancient legends,
cosmogony etc.) as also all panegyrists, all those proficient in the use of musical instruments,
courtesans all collected together, the queen-mothers, ministers, army-men and their wives,
brahmanas accompanied by Ksha

sanskrit:
भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नः परवीरहा || ६-१२७-५

विष्टीरनेकसाहस्रीश्चोदयामास भागशः |

समीकुरुत निम्नानि विषमाणि समानि च || ६-१२७-६

स्थानानि च निरस्यन्तां नन्दिग्रामादितः परम् |
translation:
"Let the cavities on the path from Nandigrama to Ayodhya be levelled. Let the rough
and the even places be made flat."

sanskrit:
सिञ्चन्तु पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां हिमशीतेन वारिणा || ६-१२७-७

ततो&अम्प्;&अम्प्;अभ्यवकिरंस्त्वन्ये लाजैः पुष्पैश्च सर्वतः |
translation:
"Let the entire ground be sprinkled with ice-gold water. Let some others strew it
all over with parched grains and flowers."

sanskrit:
समुच्छ्रितपताकास्तु रथ्याः पुरवरोत्तमे || ६-१२७-८

शोभयन्तु च वेश्मानि सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति |
translation:
"Let the streets in Ayodhya, the excellent City, be lined with flags. Let the
dwellings (on the road-side) be decorated, till the time of rising of the sun."

sanskrit:
स्रग्दाममुक्तपुष्पैश्च सुगन्धैः पञ्चवर्णकैः || ६-१२७-९

राजमार्गमसम्बाधं किरन्तु शतशो नराः |
translation:
"Let hundreds of men sprinkle, on the main royal highway, with five fragrant colours
and with rows of garlands as well as lose flowers."

sanskrit:
ततस्तच्छासनं श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नस्य मुदान्विताः || ६-१२७-१०

धृष्टिर्जयन्तो विजयः सिद्धार्थश्चार्थसाधकः |

अशोको मन्त्रपालश्च सुमन्त्रश्चापि निर्ययुः || ६-१२७-११

मत्तैर्नागसहस्रैश्च शातकुम्भविभूषितः |

अपरे हेमकक्ष्याभिः सगजाभिः करेणुभिः || ६-१२७-१२

निर्ययुस्त्वरया युक्ता रथैश्च सुमहारथाः |

शक्त्यष्टिपाशहस्तानां सध्वजानां पताकिनाम् || ६-१२७-१३

तुरगाणां सहस्त्रैश्च मुख्यैर्मुख्यतरान्वितैः |

पदातीनां सहस्त्रैश्च वीराः परिवृता ययुः || ६-१२७-१४

ततो यानान्युपारूढाः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः |

कौसल्यां प्रमुखे कृत्वा सुमित्रां चापि निर्ययुः || ६-१२७-१५

कैकेय्या सहिताः सर्वा नन्दिग्राममुपागमन् |

द्विजातिमुख्यैर्धर्मात्मा श्रेणीमुख्यैः सनैगमैः || ६-१२७-१६

माल्यमोदक हस्तैश्च मन्त्रिभिर्भरतो वृतः |

शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च बन्दिभिश्चाभिवन्दितः || ६-१२७-१७

आर्यपादौ गृहीत्वा तु शिरसा धर्मकोविदः |

पाण

अश्वानां खरशब्दैश्च रथनेमिस्वनेन च |

शङ्खदुन्दुभिनादेन संचचालेव मेदिनी || ६-१२७-२१

कृत्स्नं तु नगरं ततु नन्दिग्राममुपागमत् |

समीक्ष्य भरतो वाक्यमुवाच पवनात्मजम् || ६-१२७-२२

कच्चिन्न खलु कापेयी सेव्यते चलचित्तता |

न हि पश्यामि काकुत्स्थं राममार्यं परन्तपम् || ६-१२७-२३
translation:
"Indeed, I hope the fickle-mindedness which constitutes the peculiarity of monkeys,
has not been resorted to by you. For I do not indeed see Rama, a worthy scion of Kakutthsa and the
destroyer of adversaries."

sanskrit:
अथैवमुक्ते वचने हनूमानिदमब्रवीत् |

अर्थं विज्ञापयन्नेव भरतं सत्यविक्रमम् || ६-१२७-२४

सदा फलान्कुसुमितान्वृक्षान्प्राप्य मधुस्रवान् |

भरद्वाजप्रसादेन मत्तभ्रमरनादितान् || ६-१२७-२५

तस्य चैष वरो दत्तो वासवेन परन्तप |

ससैन्यस्य तदातिथ्यं कृतं सर्वगुणान्वितम् || ६-१२७-२६

निस्वनः श्रूयत
translation:
"A formidable roar of rejoiced monkeys is being heard, for, they are seeing on the
way, trees which continually, yield fruit, adorned with blossom, flowing with honey which is drunk
by bees, making reverberant humming sounds - all due to the grace of Sage Bharadwaja O Bharata, the
destroyer of adver

sanskrit:
रजोवर्षं समुद्भूतं पश्य वालुकिनीं प्रति |

मन्ये सालवनं रम्यं लोलयन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः || ६-१२७-२८
translation:
"See the cloud of dust, shooting froths towards the grove of Sala trees. I presume
that the monkeys are shaking the beautiful grove of Sala trees."

sanskrit:
तदेतद्दृश्यते दूराद्विमलं चन्द्रसंनिभम् |

विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यं मनसा ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् || ६-१२७-२९
translation:
"There is seen, in distance, that very famous aerial car, shining brightly like the
moon. The wonderful aerial car called Pushpaka was built with his intelligence by Viswakarma (an
architect of gods, who has been referred to here as Brahma by virtue of his creative talent.)."

sanskrit:
रावणं बान्धवैः सार्धं हत्वा लब्धं महात्मना |

तरुणादित्यसंकाशं विमानं रामवाहनम् || ६-१२७-३०

धनदस्य प्रसादेन दिव्यमेतन्मनोजवम् |
translation:
"This wonderful aerial car, with a speed of thought, which is carrying the great
souled Rama, and shines brightly like the rising sun, belongs to Kubera, the lord of riches, by the
grace of brahma, the lord of creation. (Who bestowed it on him)"

sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्भ्रातरौ वीरौ वैदेह्या सह राघवौ || ६-१२७-३१

सुग्रीवश्च महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः |
translation:
"In the same aerial car are the valiant Rama and Lakshmana, the brothers, along with
Seetha, the immensely brilliant Sugreeva and Vibhishana the demon."

sanskrit:
ततो हर्षसमुद्भूतो निस्वनो दिवमस्पृशत् || ६-१२७-३२

स्त्रीबालयुववृद्धानां रामो&अम्प्;&अम्प्;अयमिति कीर्तितः |

रथकुञ्जरवाजिभ्यस्ते&अम्प्;&अम्प्;अवतीर्य महीं गताः || ६-१२७-३३

ददृशुस्तं विमानस्थं नराः सोममिवाम्बरे |

प्राञ्जलिर्भरतो भूत्वा प्रहृष्टो राघवोन्मुखः || ६-१२७-३४

स्वागतेन यथार्थेन ततो राममपूजयत् |

मनसा ब्रह्मणा सृष्टे विमाने लक्ष्मणाग्रजः || ६-१२७-३५

रराज पृथुदीर्घाक्षो वज्रपाणिरिवापरः |

ततो विमानाग्रगतं भरतो भ्रातरं तदा || ६-१२७-३६

ववन्दे प्रणतो रामं मेरुस्थमिव भास्करम् |

ततो रामाभ्यनुज्ञातं तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् || ६-१२७-३७

हंसयुक्तं महावेगम् निपपात महीतले |

आरोपितो विमानं तद्भरतः सत्यविक्रमः || ६-१२७-३८

राममासाद्य मुदितः पुनरेवाभ्यवादयत् |

तं समुत्थाप्य काकुत्स्थश्चिरस्याक्षिपथं गतम् || ६-१२७-३९

अङ्के भरतमारोप्य मुदितः परिषष्वजे |

ततो लक्ष्मणमासाद्य वैदेहीं च परन्तपः || ६-१२७-४०

अभ्यवादयत प्रीतो भरतो नाम चाब्रवीत् |

सुग्रीवं कैकयी पुत्रो जाम्बवन्तं तथाङ्गदम् || ६-१२७-४१

मैन्दं च द्विविदं नीलमृषभं चैव सस्वजे |

सुषेणं च नलं चैव गवाक्षम् गन्धमादनम् || ६-१२७-४२

शरभं पनसं चैव परितह् परिष्स्वजे |

ते कृत्वा मानुषं रूपं वानराः कामरूपिणः || ६-१२७-४३

कुशलं पर्यपृषन्त प्रहृष्टा भरतं तदा |

अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रः सुग्रीवं वानरर्षभम् || ६-१२७-४४

परिष्वज्य महातेजा भरतो धर्मिणां वरः |

त्वमस्माकं चतुर्णां वैभ्राता सुग्रीव पञ्चमः || ६-१२७-४५

सौहार्दाज्जायते मित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम् |
translation:
"You are a fifth brother, for all the four of us, O Sugreeva! A friend is born of
affection, while malifience is the attribute of an adversary."

sanskrit:
विभीषणं च भरतः सान्त्वयन्वाक्यमब्रवीत् || ६-१२७-४६

दिष्ट्या त्वया सहायेन कृतं कर्म सुदुष्करम् |

शत्रुघ्नश्च तदा राममभिवाद्य सलक्ष्मणम् || ६-१२७-४७

सीतायाश्चरणौ पश्चाद्ववन्दे विनयान्वितः |

रामो मातरमासाद्य विषण्णं शोककर्शिताम् || ६-१२७-४८

जग्राह प्रणतः पादौ मनो मातुः प्रसादयन् |

अभिवाद्य सुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम् || ६-१२७-४९

स मातॄश्च तदा सर्वाः पुरोहितमुपागमत् |

स्वागतं ते महाबाहो कौसल्यानन्दवर्धन || ६-१२७-५०

इति प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे नागरा राममब्रुवन् |

तन्यञ्जलिसहस्राणि प्रगृहीतानि नागरैः || ६-१२७-५१

व्याकोशानीव पद्मानि ददर्श भरताग्रजः |

पादुके ते तु रामस्य गृहीत्वा भरतः स्वयम् || ६-१२७-५२

चरणाभ्यां नरेन्द्रस्य योजयामास धर्मवित् |

अब्रवीच्च तदा रामं भरतः स कृताञ्जलिः || ६-१२७-५३

एतत्ते रक्षितं राजन्राज्यं निर्यातितं मया |

अद्य जन्म कृतार्थं मे संवृत्तश्च मनोरथः || ६-१२७-५४

यस्त्वां पश्यामि राजानमयोध्यां पुनरागतम् |
translation:
"My life has accomplished its purpose today and my wish too stands fulfilled, in
that I see you, its king, come back to Ayodhya."

sanskrit:
अवेक्षतां भवान्कोशं कोष्ठागारं पुरं बलम् || ६-१२७-५५

भवतस्तेजसा सर्वं कृतं दशगुणं मया |
translation:
"You review your treasury, granary, palace of your spirit, everything has been
enhanced tenfold by me."

sanskrit:
तथा ब्रुवाणं भरतं दृष्ट्वा तं भ्रातृवत्सलम् || ६-१२७-५६

मुमुचुर्वानरा बाष्पं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः |

ततः प्रहर्षाद्भरतमङ्कमारोप्य राघवः || ६-१२७-५७

ययौ तेन विमानेन ससैन्यो भरताश्रमम् |

भरताश्रममासाद्य ससैन्यो राघवस्तदा || ६-१२७-५८

अवतीर्य विमानाग्रादवतस्थे महीतले |

अब्रवीच्च तदा रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् || ६-१२७-५९

वह वैश्रवणं देवमनुजानामि गम्यताम् |

ततो रामाभ्यनुज्ञातं तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् || ६-१२७-६०

उत्तरां दिशमुद्दिश्य जगाम धनदालयम् |

विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यं सम्गृहीतं तु रक्षसा || ६-१२७-६१

अगमद्धनदं वेगाद्रामवाक्यप्रचोदितम् |

पुरोहितस्यात्मसमस्य राघवो |

बृहस्पतेः शक्र इवामराधीअपः |

निपीड्य पादौ पृथगासने शुभे |

सहैव तेनोपविवेश वीर्यवान् || ६-१२७-६२

शिरस्यञ्जलिमादाय कैकेयीनन्दिवर्धनः |

बभाषे भरतो ज्येष्ठन् रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् || ६-१२८-१

पूजिता मामिका माता दत्तन् राज्यमिदं मम |

तद्ददामि पुनस्तुभ्यन् यथा त्वमददा मम || ६-१२८-२
translation:
"You gave this kingdom to me and treated my mother's words respectfully. As you gave
it to me then, in the same way I am giving it to you again.

sanskrit:
धुरमेकाकिना न्यस्तामृषभेण बलीयसा |

किशोरवद्गुरुं भारं न वोढुमहमुत्सहे || ६-१२८-३

वारिवेगेन महता भिन्नः सेतुरिव क्षरन् |

दुर्बन्धनमिदं मन्ये राज्यच्छिद्रमसन्वृतम् || ६-१२८-४
translation:
"I think this venerable point in the form of administration of the kingdom is
difficult to be controlled, as a broken dam, seeping from its cracks when breached mammoth stream
of water.

sanskrit:
गतिं खर इवाश्वस्य हन्सस्येव च वायसः |

नान्वेतुमुत्सहे देव तव मार्गमरिन्दम || ६-१२८-५
